If a date's file is missing, the time does not match or the grid does not cover the scene, the step raises E201/E204 naming the date and the file. bosar aux status walk --for dinsar+gacos lists in advance what is missing, what can be fetched automatically (with the command) and what you have to do by hand.

docs.title: Step 22: SBAS network design
docs.text:
bosar sbas network walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --max-dt 400 --max-bperp 300 --k 2 --name crop

Selects pairs by the Δt / |B⊥| thresholds, then adds for each date the --k nearest connections in time (so gaps stay connected), and reports the connected components, the redundancy (pairs / dates) and the number of triplets; rejected pairs are recorded with their reason in project.json (aux.sbas.networks). Your own network_design.csv can be imported with --from-csv (B⊥ taken from the stack's orbital baselines). The 5 dates of the crop: 9 pairs, 1 rejected (|B⊥| 392 m but kept as a sequential connection), 7 triplets, connected. In the GUI, choose SBAS prep on the Run page to design the network and view the network plot (selected pairs solid, rejected pairs dashed).

docs.title: Step 23: Derive the small-baseline interferograms, common reference point, batch unwrapping
docs.text:
bosar sbas prep walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --network crop --looks 2,10 --backend snaphu --workers 3 --nproc 2 --tag sbas

Step ids carry the network name (coherence_<pair>_crop_sbas), so the networks of the two stacks in one project do not interfere. Four resumable phases: prepare: for each pair ifg_derive → multilook → coherence (ifg_derive computes the flattened (i, j) pair from the star-stack diff(ref,i), diff(ref,j) and the reference image power; the coherence uses the same numerator and the two SLC powers); reference: among the pixels coherent (≥ 0.3) in every pair, the one with the highest mean coherence becomes the common reference point (written into the network record); unwrap: SNAPHU for each pair (smooth cost), unified reference; closure: see the next step. --workers 3 runs three pairs in parallel (subprocesses, CPU), and the concurrent writes to project.json are merged by revision number. The 9 pairs of the crop: prepare about 1 minute per pair, unwrap 1–3 seconds per pair, reference pixel (20, 167).

docs.title: Step 24: Triplet closure (B4)
docs.text:
The last phase of sbas prep is closure; it can also be run on its own:

bosar sbas prep walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --network crop --phase closure --looks 2,10 --tag sbas

Each closed triangle gets two quantities: the wrapped-phase closure arg(c_ij c_jk conj(c_ik)) (phase bias) and the integer closure of the unwrapped phase round((u_ij + u_jk − u_ik − w)/2π) (unwrapping errors); products closure/wrapped_rms, closure/integer_count; the summary has per-triplet, per-pair (with a "systematic error" flag) and coherent-pixels-only statistics. The 7 triplets of the crop: median wrapped closure RMS 0.94 rad (0.43–0.52 rad on pixels coherent in all three pairs), 9–24 % of pixels with non-zero integer closure (2–11 % on coherent pixels; the summer triplet 20240821-0902-0914 is best, 2.2 %).

docs.title: Step 25: Preprocessing with SNAP (requires an installed ESA SNAP)
docs.text:
bosar preflight --offline
bosar pipeline preprocess walk --engine snap --product "$DATA\00_RawData\S1A_IW_SLC__1SDV_20240821T234025_20240821T234052_055318_06BEBA_E05B.zip" --product "$DATA\00_RawData\S1A_IW_SLC__1SDV_20240902T234025_20240902T234052_055493_06C53E_B90F.zip" --product "$DATA\00_RawData\S1A_IW_SLC__1SDV_20240914T234026_20240914T234052_055668_06CC28_B2FF.zip" --subswath IW2 --aoi-wkt "POLYGON((-86.30 39.65,-86.00 39.65,-86.00 39.90,-86.30 39.90,-86.30 39.65))" --threads 8 --cache-mb 8192 --tag subset

Preflight's P402 reports SNAP's gpt, toolboxes and heap memory. The command calls SNAP as a separate program (no SNAP code is copied or imported): TOPSAR-Split (bursts chosen by the AOI) → Apply-Orbit-File (the local orbits found in step 18, copied to walk/snap/userdir) → Back-Geocoding (external DEM = the ellipsoidal mosaic of step 19, walk/aux/dem) → ESD → Interferogram (flat-earth + topographic phase, coherence, elevation, lat/lon) → Deburst; the product is BEAM-DIMAP and is then imported automatically (data import --reader dimap --ifg-dim) as the stack snap_subset, which every command from step 8 onward can use. Everything SNAP writes is under walk/snap/ and walk/products/dimap/; not one file in ~/.snap is touched. On this machine: stack 90 s, interferogram 344 s, gpt peak memory 45 GB (the -Xmx132G in gpt.vmoptions allows it). Note: the DEM is mosaicked only for the AOI box, and Back-Geocoding blanks every pixel without elevation, so the subset has data only inside the AOI box.

docs.title: Step 26: Which pairs and pixels are dropped when coherence is insufficient
docs.text:
How good an SBAS result is depends mostly on how trustworthy the unwrapped phase fed into it is. Bosar makes "dropping" a set of explicit rules, each leaving a record in the command output and in project.json, and each can be loosened or tightened individually:

Level Rule Where to adjust Where it is recorded Whole pair Empty pair: coherence is 0 everywhere (the interferogram or SLC of that date is all zeros in the export; W206 at import) not adjustable network record empty_pairs Whole pair Weak pair: fewer than 5 % of pixels with coherence ≥ 0.4; but each date keeps its best forward and backward connection sbas prep --min-coherent-fraction 0.05 (0 = do not drop) weak_pairs, weak_pairs_kept, pair_quality Whole pair Unreliable pair: in every triplet it takes part in, more than 30 % of coherent pixels have non-zero integer closure (a scene-wide decorrelated or badly coregistered date) unw_correct --pair-max-error 0.3 unreliable_pairs in the unw_correct summary Pixel the pair's coherence at this pixel is below the threshold pipeline sbas --coh-min 0.3 sbas_invert summary pair_pixels_dropped.coherence Pixel the pixel is not in the unwrapping connected component that holds the reference point --any-component disables this rule pair_pixels_dropped.component Pixel after closure correction the triplet containing this pair still does not close --keep-unclosed disables this rule pair_pixels_dropped.unclosed_triplet

A pixel needs at least 2 remaining pairs to get a time series (--min-pairs); only when its network connects all dates into one piece and its temporal coherence is ≥ 0.7 does it enter the default mask (product ts_mask). If the whole-pair rules break the network into several segments (as happens when all the winter pairs are unreliable), sbas_invert reports W107: the offsets between segments are unknown, and the velocity is fitted as "one rate + one intercept per segment"; to bridge the break, keep more pairs across it (raise sbas network --k, lower --min-coherent-fraction, or choose yourself with sbas_invert --exclude-pairs). Network design has two more options: --sequential-only (only the k nearest connections in time for each date) and --season-months 5-10 (reject pairs that cross seasons, sequential connections excepted).

docs.title: Step 27: SBAS time series (pipeline sbas)
docs.text:
bosar pipeline sbas walk --network crop --tag sbas --tropo gacos --gacos-dir <data-root>/05_Auxiliary/00_GACOS

On the network prepared in step 23, in turn: unw_correct (corrects 2π unwrapping errors from closure loops, the phase-closure method of Yunjun et al. 2019, deduplicated by "closure pattern" so each pattern is solved once) → sbas_invert (weighted least squares / minimum-norm solution of the per-pixel network, Berardino et al. 2002; weights from coherence and the number of looks; outputs ts_los (one band per date, metres, positive toward the satellite), velocity (m/yr) with its standard deviation, temporal_coherence, n_pairs_used, ts_rank, ts_mask) → ts_correct (the GACOS slant delay of each date, referenced to the reference point and reference date; --deramp additionally removes a plane per date; --tropo era5 uses ERA5 pressure-level data and needs a CDS key) → geocoding (velocity, temporal coherence, time series). Inside the products everything is metres and metres per year; only the GUI, CSV and summaries switch to millimetres. The correction method is written into the step id (ts_correct_crop_sbas_gacos), so uncorrected, GACOS and ERA5 results can coexist for comparison. This 5-scene crop has only 9 pairs, and the result only demonstrates the workflow; the 26-scene crop (data/indy_downtown_ts, see the release notes) is where a proper time series appears.

docs.title: Step 28: Export for comparison with MintPy (optional)
docs.text:
bosar sbas export-mintpy walk --network crop --tag sbas --out walk\mintpy

Writes inputs/ifgramStack.h5, inputs/geometryRadar.h5 and a minimal smallbaselineApp.cfg (file formats follow the MintPy manual; no MintPy code is used). MintPy, run as a separate program on these files (ifgram_inversion.py inputs/ifgramStack.h5 -w var), can then be compared with Bosar on exactly the same input; --mintpy-legacy-bperp writes the baselines as the .base values of the export, consistent with your earlier MintPy data set.

docs.title: Step 29: Viewing time series, stacking layers and exporting figures in the GUI
docs.text:
bosar gui walk → Results page:

  • Select geo_velocity (the velocity map): in the Layers panel at the bottom left choose a basemap (default "none"; since v0.4.0 the release no longer connects to any tile server by default; the 2016 Sentinel-2 cloudless mosaic is CC BY and can be used directly, OpenStreetMap and Esri each have terms of use, and a custom XYZ takes its template, key and attribution in Settings); the basemap can be dimmed; each layer has a visibility switch, 0–100 % opacity (70 % by default over a basemap), stacking order and a "transparent where coherence / temporal coherence is below the threshold" mask; "Add selected as layer" stacks another geocoded product selected in the tree. Radar-geometry products are never silently reprojected; instead a "Geocode for the map" button runs the geocode step.
  • Click a pixel on the velocity map: the LOS displacement time series of that pixel (millimetres) appears below with its linear fit and rate (mm/yr); several pixels can be clicked, different corrections ticked (uncorrected / GACOS / ERA5) and a CSV exported; in the radar-geometry view the reference point is marked with a star.
  • "Export view…" saves the current view as PNG or PDF: with colour bar, one legend row per layer, scale bar, north arrow and basemap attribution; the commands that produced each layer are written into the file metadata.

docs.title: Step 30: Is the result usable? Quality verdict and data health check
docs.text:
bosar sbas quality walk --network crop --tag sbas

Every time-series chain (pipeline sbas, pipeline psds) prints a quality verdict when it finishes: USABLE / MARGINAL (readable only within the stated limits) / NOT USABLE (must not be interpreted as deformation). The verdict comes from measured metrics, each with a warning code, the measured value, the threshold and a concrete remedy:

Code Metric Marginal Not usable W108 fraction of pixels connected and meeting the temporal-coherence threshold < 20 % < 2 % W109 fraction of dropped interferogram pairs, or dates lost entirely > 30 % or a date lost — W107 network broken into segments yes — W110 velocity spread of the usable pixels > 4 mm/yr > 10 mm/yr W111 fraction of triplets still unclosed after correction > 15 % — W112 median velocity clearly offset from the reference point (a scene-wide ramp or a bad reference point) yes — W113 fraction of pixels with a jump of nearly half a wavelength between adjacent epochs (and from which date it starts) > 3 % —

bosar sbas quality also prints a per-date data health table: how many pairs each date has, how many are empty (all zeros), how many too weak, how many judged unreliable by the closure check, the mean coherent-pixel fraction. A date whose pairs are all empty is a data problem (that scene is empty in the export; tuning parameters will not help, only re-coregistration or exclusion); a date whose pairs all fail was decorrelated that day (snow, rain, leaf fall). In the GUI, the Results page shows the same verdict in a banner above the map.

docs.title: Step 31: PS / DS time series (pipeline psds)
docs.text:
bosar pipeline psds walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --strides 2,10 --workers 3 --backend snaphu

Where vegetation is dense, multilooked SBAS keeps few pixels. This chain uses two kinds of scatterers instead: distributed scatterers (DS): around each pixel, find statistically homogeneous neighbours (SHP, a GLRT test on amplitude), estimate the N×N coherence matrix over those neighbours, and estimate the phases of all N dates at once by phase linking (EMI); persistent scatterers (PS): points with amplitude dispersion D_A ≤ 0.25 keep their own phase. The two are merged into one "hybrid stack", which then goes through the same unwrapping, closure and inversion as steps 23–27. In order: slc_flatten (flattens each SLC with Bosar's own flat-earth phase; it also scans every date, and a date with a missing band is detected and dropped by default, W207) → psds_link (SHP, phase linking, PS selection; 26 scenes of 768×3072 take only a dozen seconds on the GPU) → the interferogram of each pair → unwrapping → closure correction → inversion → geocoding → quality verdict. Common options: --shp glrt|ks, --method emi|evd, --ps-da 0.25, --strides azimuth,range (decimation of the output grid), --ds-tcoh 0.6 (the phase-linking temporal coherence a DS needs; pure noise reaches at most 0.36 on this stack), --keep-partial-dates. The 5-scene crop only demonstrates the workflow (with so few dates phase linking means little); results on the 26-scene test area are in the release notes.

docs.title: Step 32: Classic PS-InSAR as an independent cross-check (pipeline psi)
docs.text:
bosar pipeline psi walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --name psds --max-arc-m 3000

Classic PSI re-implemented after Ferretti et al. 2001 / Kampes 2006, with neither phase linking nor spatial unwrapping: PS candidates (D_A) → the edges of a Delaunay triangulation → each edge estimates height error and rate jointly with a periodogram (batched in one matrix multiplication) → integration from the reference point along the most coherent path → atmospheric phase screen estimated from the residuals and removed → final estimate per point. The result is a GeoPackage point layer (products/psi_points/): LOS velocity (positive toward the satellite), height error, temporal coherence and the displacement of each date. The acceptance threshold is raised automatically above the "99th percentile of pure noise" for this stack's number of dates (with few dates, noise alone can produce a high temporal coherence). It reuses the flattened stack slc_flatten_psds of the previous step.

docs.title: Step 33: Viewing PS/DS results in the GUI
docs.text: bosar gui walk → choose PS / DS time series on the Run page to run the command above directly; on the Results page, with a PS/DS velocity map selected, tick PS points to draw the persistent scatterers as points (colour = velocity, size = quality) and click one to see its time series; the quality maps psds_temporal_coherence, shp_count, psds_type, amp_dispersion can be viewed directly. When the network is broken into segments, the time series is drawn as one line per segment with one offset each (the displacement between segments is unknown).

docs.title: Step 34: Downloading raw SLCs from ASF (fetch slc)
docs.text:
bosar fetch slc --project demo_dinsar --stack gamma_01_IW2 --range 2025-08-01:2026-09-30 --dry-run
bosar fetch slc --project demo_dinsar --stack gamma_01_IW2 --range 2025-08-01:2026-09-30 --range 2023-07-01:2024-06-30 --dest data/raw/s1 --detach
bosar fetch status --dest data/raw/s1
bosar fetch stop --dest data/raw/s1

Searches ASF for scenes by the stack's relative orbit, frame and footprint (or --aoi "POINT(lon lat)" + --relative-orbit); --dry-run only lists the scenes and sizes; the real download is Bosar's own loop: resumable (Range), verified by size and MD5, one <name>.json provenance record per scene, stops when free space falls below --min-free-gb (default 150 GB), and the second batch starts only when free space exceeds --continue-if-free-gb. --detach runs it in the background and continues across sessions; the progress file fetch_slc_progress.json and fetch_slc.log are in the destination directory. Earthdata credentials go through ~/.netrc or the keychain, never through chat. The Aux page has the same card. The destination refuses a read-only data root.

docs.title: Step 35: Native TOPS coregistration: from zip to stack without SNAP (pipeline s1-coregister)
docs.text:
bosar project new demo_native
bosar fetch dem demo_native --bbox -86.52,39.27,-85.06,40.28 --margin-deg 0
bosar pipeline s1-coregister demo_native --product <zip1> --product <zip2> --product <zip3> --subswath IW2 --pol VV --aoi-wkt "POLYGON((-86.30 39.65,-86.00 39.65,-86.00 39.90,-86.30 39.90,-86.30 39.65))" --tag r11
bosar fetch orbits demo_native --stack native_r11 --no-download
bosar run demo_native slc_flatten --step-id slc_flatten_r11 --stack native_r11

The first zip is the reference. One step does it all: extract the sub-swath's annotation and image from the zip into cache/safe/ (once), build the burst model from the annotation, precise orbits (those recorded in the project, else the data root / SNAP cache, else the annotation ephemeris with W301), topo on a grid with the DEM for each reference burst, deramp of each secondary burst → Knab-window sinc resampling by the orbit + DEM offsets → reramp, ESD in the burst overlaps iterated to within 0.001 lines, stitching along the overlap mid-lines (deburst), written in the ISCE merged/ layout (--output cint16 halves the space) and imported automatically as the stack native_<tag>. On an RTX 3090 one 1500 × 25000 burst takes under 1 second (CPU 55 seconds). products/native/stack/<step>.json records the burst parameters, the stitching plan, the ESD table and offsets of each date, and the timings. The comparison with SNAP on the same three scenes (scripts/validate_native_tops.py, scripts/validate_native_flat.py) is in the release notes.

docs.title: Step 36: Empty-scene health check at import and per-band quality thresholds
docs.text: bosar data import now scans each date by sampling (16 rows out of every 128): an all-zero date gets W206, a date whose zero fraction exceeds the "common floor" (the region that is zero on every date, scene edges and burst gaps; the minimum zero fraction across dates, W208) by more than 2 percentage points gets W207, recorded in the stack record's warnings and in each date record's zero_fraction / partially_empty / empty; the time-series chains still drop W207 dates by default. The quality verdict picks thresholds by band: C-band is the default, L-band is a draft (the millimetre-scale thresholds scaled by the wavelength ratio), and the second output line says thresholds: C-band (default).

docs.title: Step 37: Classic PSI and the point layer in the GUI
docs.text: bosar gui walk → the Run page gains Classic PS-InSAR (periodogram) (the command of step 32, with D_A, point count, longest edge and temporal coherence as basic parameters; in the plan it is slc_flatten_psi + psi_classic_psi); on the Results page, with a PSI result selected, tick PS points and the points in the GeoPackage are drawn coloured by velocity and sized by temporal coherence, by the same mechanism as the PS/DS point layer.

docs.title: Step 38: Multi-year native stack: every zip in a directory, cropped to the AOI, resumable
docs.text:
bosar project new demo_multi
bosar fetch dem demo_multi --bbox -86.52,39.27,-85.06,40.28 --margin-deg 0
bosar fetch orbits demo_multi --product <reference zip> --product <other zips…>
bosar pipeline s1-coregister demo_multi --product <reference zip> --products-from <data-root>/00_RawData --products-from data/raw/s1 --subswath IW2 --aoi-wkt "POLYGON((-86.30 39.65,-86.00 39.65,-86.00 39.90,-86.30 39.90,-86.30 39.65))" --crop-wkt "POLYGON((-86.245 39.692,-86.078 39.692,-86.078 39.813,-86.245 39.813,-86.245 39.692))" --drop-cache --tag multi
bosar pipeline psds demo_multi --stack native_multi --workers 6 --tropo era5 --ref-latlon 39.7684,-86.1581 --no-correct --keep-unclosed
bosar pipeline psi demo_multi --stack native_multi --name psds --max-arc-m 3000

--products-from takes every S1?_IW_SLC__*.zip in the folder sorted by date (S1A and S1D alike); bursts are selected by the intersection of the AOI polygon with each burst footprint; --crop-wkt writes only the bounding box of the polygon to disk (bursts are still coregistered whole). One date is processed at a time: open → deramp → geometric offsets → range cross-correlation check → ESD → stitch → write → close, so memory does not grow with the number of dates; each date writes a merged/SLC/<date>/coreg.json (the signature of the settings), and running the same command again processes only the newly downloaded dates (n_reused in the summary). The default output is CINT16 (--output cfloat switches back). fetch orbits --product fetches precise orbits by product name before any stack exists. 53 dates (2024-07 to 2026-07, including 2 S1D scenes) take about 53 seconds per scene on an RTX 3090. The third line of the quality verdict gives "measured velocity spread vs the spread expected from the number of dates and the time span": sigma_v = sigma_d * sqrt(12 (N-1) / (N (N+1))) / T. On long stacks (two years, nearly 200 pairs) add --no-correct --keep-unclosed: the closure correction step corrupts the unwrapped result on a network this large (to be fixed), and the unclosed pairs are kept and judged by temporal coherence. With that, on two years of data PS/DS is USABLE (26.5 % of pixels reliable, velocity spread 1.45 mm/yr, expected 1.1), classic PSI is USABLE too (1.26 mm/yr), and the two chains differ by 0.4–0.6 mm/yr on reliable pixels. Do not read relative velocities across coherence gaps (for example the two banks of a river). Time-series projects are best created with bosar project new --storage-mode full.

docs.title: Step 39: Calibration and terrain flattening (--calibration, --terrain-flatten)
docs.text:
bosar pipeline s1-coregister demo_native --product <zip1> --product <zip2> --subswath IW2 --bursts 6,8 --output cfloat --calibration sigma0 --terrain-flatten --tag cal
bosar pipeline amplitude demo_native --stack native_cal --pre 20240821 --post 20240902

The SLC keeps its DN unchanged; merged/calibrated/<date>/<date>.sigma0.rdr (or beta0 / gamma0) is linear power computed with the SAFE calibration LUT, gamma0_flat.rdr = beta0 × area factor (Small 2011; the factor is computed in radar geometry from DEM facets, equals tan(incidence angle) on flat ground, and is NaN in layover and shadow), and the factor itself is in geom_reference/gamma_flat_factor.rdr. When a native stack carries calibration layers, the amplitude-change chain switches automatically to absolute backscatter (dB (sigma0), no more relative normalisation). The comparison with SNAP's Calibration / Terrain-Flattening: scripts/validate_native_cal.py.

docs.title: Step 40: Three sub-swaths and swath merging (--subswath IW1,IW2,IW3)
docs.text:
bosar project new demo_full
bosar fetch dem demo_full --bbox -87.65,38.40,-84.001,40.75 --margin-deg 0
bosar pipeline s1-coregister demo_full --product <zip1> --product <zip2> --subswath IW1,IW2,IW3 --tag full --id native_full

Each sub-swath is coregistered once (steps s1_coregister_full_iw1…3; without --bursts / --aoi-wkt that means all bursts), then s1_swath_merge_full merges the three stacks onto one range / azimuth grid: whole-pixel placement (as in ISCE2), cut along the overlap mid-line, no interpolation at all; the geometry layers are merged the same way, so every pixel carries its own lat/lon. The seams in the summary give the phase, coherence and amplitude step of each seam for each date. The DEM mosaic is read by window, so even a full scene is never loaded whole into memory.

docs.title: Step 41: Split-spectrum ionosphere estimation (iono_split)
docs.text:
bosar run demo_full slc_flatten --step-id slc_flatten_full --stack native_full
bosar run demo_full iono_split --step-id iono_full --requires slc_flatten_full --pair 20240821_20240902

On the flattened SLC stack: the upper and lower thirds of the range spectrum are each extracted to form sub-band interferograms, the full band is unwrapped only once, the dispersive term is computed from the two sub-band phases (Gomba 2016), and a coherence-weighted Gaussian low-pass is applied. The output is iono_phase/<pair> (the ionospheric phase at the carrier frequency, radians, multilook grid); the summary has the plane slope of the unwrapped phase before and after correction. Noise is amplified about 120 times, hence the default 64 × 256 looks. The constant term cannot be determined (like every interferometric phase, it is relative).

docs.title: Step 42: GUI: the Coregister workflow and download batches
docs.text: bosar gui demo_multi → Coregister (Bosar) on the Run page: Engine bosar (the native chain, the command of step 38) or snap (the SNAP bridge of step 25); ticking "all three sub-swaths" gives step 40; the form has output type, calibration and terrain flattening. The Sentinel-1 SLC scenes (ASF) card on the Aux page now lists the progress of each batch, the file being transferred and the remaining time estimated from the rate of the last minute; bosar fetch slc --parallel 3 downloads in parallel, and scenes interrupted by the network are retried automatically on a later attempt.

docs.title: Step 43: Temporal reference date and outlier dates
docs.text:
bosar pipeline sbas demo_multi --network psds --no-correct --ref-latlon 39.7684,-86.1581 --tropo era5
bosar pipeline sbas demo_multi --network psds --tag ex5 --no-correct --ref-latlon 39.7684,-86.1581 --fit huber --exclude-dates 20230803,20240330,20240622,20250325,20250816

Without --ref-date, the zero date of the series is no longer the first scene but follows the "common-mode median" rule: for each date take the spatial median of the good pixels (the amount by which the whole scene moves relative to the reference pixel, mostly atmosphere) and pick the date closest to the median of those medians, which is never an outlier day. The summary records ref_date_rule, common_mode_mm. W117 names the dates that "deviate from the fitted line by more than 3 robust standard deviations on more than 20 % of pixels"; --exclude-dates removes them with all their pairs, --fit huber estimates the velocity with a Huber estimator, and the quality report prints both the least-squares and the Huber spread. --tag can now name a variant of the time-series part only, with the pair products reusing the network's own.

docs.title: Step 44: ΔSTEC implied by the range shifts
docs.text:
bosar aux range-shift demo_multi --stack native_multi --ionex-dir data/aux/ionex --write
bosar sbas quality demo_multi --network psds

For each date: the shift predicted by the ERA5 troposphere, the residual, and the slant TEC difference obtained by treating the residual as ionospheric group delay (one 2.33 m pixel ≈ 169 TECU); when IONEX maps are present the GIM value is given alongside. --write writes them into each date's coreg.json and the coregistration step summary, and the per-date table of sbas quality gains three columns shift[px], dSTEC[TECU], GIM[TECU].

docs.title: Step 45: Ionospheric model correction (optional)
docs.text:
bosar pipeline sbas demo_multi --network psds --iono --iono-model plane
bosar pipeline psds demo_alos --stack alos_mx --network l --iono --iono-looks 32,32

Without --iono nothing happens. With it, each interferogram pair gets one split-spectrum estimate and a model fit (C-band defaults to plane, L-band to filtered), and the model is subtracted at the read-in stage of the inversion; at the end of the chain it prints the model span, the number of W220 pairs and the triplet closure. Every model passes a plausibility gate first (span, gradient, triplet closure; --no-iono-gate switches it off): a model that fails is skipped and counted (W227), so a bad estimate never enters the inversion.

What the correction is worth, measured on real stacks (0.4.1): at C band (Sentinel-1, Indianapolis, 88 winter dates) no measurable benefit - the gate passes a handful of pairs and the velocities change by less than their own noise; at L band (ALOS-1, Mexico City) the gate keeps about half of the models and the product is unchanged within 0.01 mm/yr. The gate is on by default because a filtered model can follow the deformation it sits on, and that is what the gate's span and closure rules catch. Use --iono with the gate, compare the velocity map with and without it, and keep the run whose residuals and landmark series you can defend; it stays opt-in.

NISAR records two frequency bands in one granule (mode 0505: 1221.5 MHz on frequency A, 1236.5 MHz on B, 5 MHz each, one grid). Coregister the second band as its own stack (pipeline stripmap-coregister … --reader nisar --frequency B --tag b) and name it:

bosar pipeline sbas demo_nisar --network l --iono --iono-band-stack stripmap_b

The ionosphere then comes from the two full bands instead of the outer thirds of one (the bands source of the iono_split step): 15 MHz between the carriers against 3.3 MHz, a noise gain of 58 instead of 259 - four to five times less noise for the same looks. The two stacks may carry different polarisations (HH on A, VV on B in that mode); each band's interferogram is formed within itself. The estimator is verified on synthetic bands; on the provisional 0505 granules of 2026 (track 58, frame 53) frequency B held no signal, so look at band.coherence_median in the iono_split summary before trusting a run.

docs.title: Step 46: Sequential phase linking for long series and the star-unwrapping experiment
docs.text:
bosar pipeline psds demo_multi --stack native_multi --network psds_seq --method sequential --ministack 15
bosar pipeline psds demo_multi --unwrap star

sequential: one ministack of 15 scenes at a time, each linked on its own, with compressed SLCs chaining the datums together; the matrix never exceeds "ministack + number of earlier ministacks" dates (N/L drops from 0.9 to 0.2); the summary reports n_over_l_median. --unwrap star: only the star pairs with the first scene are measurements, the remaining pairs are derived from the star (closure identically zero), and independently unwrapped adjacent pairs are used only to vote on integer-cycle errors.

Measured on 88 scenes: sequential links 7 times faster and selects 68 % more DS, doubling the product coverage (73 % vs 37 %), but the velocity spread goes from 0.54 to 0.80 mm/yr and 6 % of pixels show integer-cycle jumps: interferogram pairs derived from linked phases close by construction, so the inversion's temporal coherence is identically 1.0 for them and cannot act as a gate. The default remains auto; sequential is an option, to be re-evaluated in v0.4.0 once the linking coherence is used as the mask. --unwrap star is also a negative result on 88 scenes: the star pairs centred on the first scene span up to 1171 days, the far pairs carry whole-scene integer-cycle errors, and the vote of three adjacent pairs per scene cannot hold them (five dates had 91–98 % of pixels changed), velocity spread 3.6 mm/yr. The default remains pairs.

docs.title: Step 47: ALOS-1 / ENVISAT / ERS / NISAR readers and the stripmap coregistration chain
docs.text:
bosar fetch slc --mission alos --path 186 --frame 370 --flight-direction ascending --range 2007-01-01:2011-12-31 --dry-run
bosar project new demo_alos --storage-mode full
bosar fetch dem demo_alos --bbox -99.30,19.15,-98.85,19.60 --tile-dir data/aux/dem_tiles
bosar pipeline stripmap-coregister demo_alos --product A.zip --product B.zip --reader alos --crop-wkt "POLYGON((...))" --id alos_pair
bosar sbas network demo_alos --stack alos_pair --name pair --max-dt 400 --max-bperp 5000
bosar run demo_alos slc_flatten --step-id slc_flatten_alos_pair --stack alos_pair --mode orbits
bosar sbas prep demo_alos --stack alos_pair --network pair --flat-step slc_flatten_alos_pair

ALOS-1 PALSAR L1.1 (CEOS, ASF's zip read directly), ENVISAT ASAR IMS and ERS IMS (Envisat format, --reader asar / ers_envisat), and NISAR RSLC (HDF5, no real data seen yet) are all read into the same StripmapScene; the stripmap coregistration chain carries the Doppler centroid (the geometry uses the Doppler term of rdr2geo/geo2rdr, resampling demodulates first and remodulates after) and writes the same ISCE directory as the TOPS chain. A native stack has no stored interferograms, so pairs must be flattened first and derived with --flat-step; with three or more scenes go straight to pipeline psds. One pair of each of the three sensors was run over Mexico City; the 16-scene ALOS series (pipeline psds demo_alos --stack alos_mx --network l --k 3, then pipeline sbas --tag ex --ref-latlon 19.342,-99.088 --exclude-dates 20100522 --fit huber) gives Nezahualcóyotl −223 mm/yr (LOS, roughly −290 vertical), the airport −192, the volcanic-rock reference point −4 ± 3, consistent in pattern and magnitude with Chaussard 2014. Two cautions: the default reference pixel (the best DS) lands in the subsidence basin, so point --ref-latlon at stable ground; and the W110/W113 of the quality verdict are designed for stable areas and will judge the deformation itself NOT USABLE on a 30 cm/yr basin.

docs.title: Step 48: Comparing two chains, the 4K tour
docs.text:
bosar compare demo_multi --list
bosar compare demo_multi products/geo_velocity/geocode_velocity_psds_era5.tif ps:psds_link_psds --out compare_out
python scripts/gui_tour.py --project tour/indy_crop --size 1920x1080 --scale 2

bosar compare is the command-line version of "Compare two chains" on the Results page; the tour screenshots are rendered at 2× scale to 3840 × 2160, each step gains one animated "where to click" hint, and the DInSAR demo is additionally saved as a 4K MP4.

docs.title: Current limitations and what comes next
docs.text:
• Input can be a GAMMA/StaMPS stack exported by SNAP, SNAP-bridged preprocessing (step 25), or, since v0.3.0, Bosar's own native TOPS coregistration (steps 35, 38–40: multi-year stacks, calibration, three-swath merging).
  • There are three time-series chains: SBAS (steps 22–27), the PS/DS hybrid stack (step 31) and classic PSI (step 32). On this vegetated C-band area the velocity noise is of the order of 2–5 mm/yr, and one year of data cannot resolve millimetre-level deformation; the quality verdict tells you so explicitly.
  • Split-spectrum ionosphere estimation is wired into the time-series chains (step 45, optional); the ALOS-1, ENVISAT and ERS readers and the stripmap coregistration chain ran on real data in v0.4.0 (step 47), NISAR only on synthetic data; offset tracking and speckle filtering are in v0.3.0; the installers in v0.4.0.

docs.title: Step 49: Quality verdict for deforming areas, linking-coherence gate, two safeguards on downloads
docs.text:
bosar pipeline sbas demo_alos --network l --tag ex2 --area deforming --exclude-dates 20100522 --fit huber --no-geocode
bosar sbas quality demo_alos --network l --tag ex2
bosar sbas quality demo_multi --network psds --step ts_correct_psds_era5 --area deforming
bosar pipeline sbas demo_multi --network psds_seq --tag gate --link-coherence-min 0.7 --tropo era5 --no-geocode
bosar fetch dem demo_alos --bbox -99.30,19.15,-98.85,19.60 --timeout-s 120
  • --area stable | deforming | auto: the stable-area rules (the default) judge a 30 cm/yr subsidence basin NOT USABLE, because the velocity spread is itself deformation and so are the integer-cycle steps between adjacent dates. In deforming mode W110 looks at the residual spread after subtracting a 1 km smoothed field from the velocity, W113 at cycle slips relative to each pixel's fitted line, W114 at the detrended common-mode steps, and W112 is no longer reported; when no reference point is given, it moves automatically to the cell with the densest coherent neighbourhood inside the "most stable quintile" of the velocity field (--stable-end max for subsidence scenes, min for uplift). auto switches to deforming when the spread exceeds 3 times the stable-area expectation. The 16-scene Mexico City series is thereby judged USABLE, with the reference point landing automatically on the volcanic rock of Cerro de la Estrella.
  • Two levels of W117: a date with more than 20 % outlier pixels is only recorded (marked (info) in the report), ≥ 35 % is marginal, and only more than two marginal dates lower the verdict; sbas quality now re-judges the stored metrics against the current thresholds, --step names the step to report on, and --area applies a different rule set to the same product.
  • --link-coherence-min 0.7: the reliable mask of PS/DS products is gated once more by the temporal coherence of phase linking; a sequentially linked stack has an inversion coherence identically 1, so this gate is mandatory, and pipeline psds --method sequential therefore carries 0.7 by default (--link-coherence-min 0 turns it off). On the three-year stack the gate keeps 82.5 % of pixels, the verdict is still marginal, and the landmark velocities differ from the ungated product by less than 0.15 mm/yr: the gate replaces the definition of "reliable", not the product.
  • fetch dem --timeout-s (the only path since v0.4.0): downloads the missing GLO-30 tiles straight from the Copernicus public bucket into <project>/aux/dem/tiles/ and then mosaics them; fetch slc checks an existing file by MD5 once and afterwards by a tail hash (the last 1 MiB) for a quick check, no longer by size alone.

docs.title: Step 50: The installed version: starting from .exe / .dmg without the source
docs.text:
Since v0.4.0 Bosar has installers; the commands below run on the installed version (not this development checkout), so they are written as plain text blocks and check_walkthrough.py does not execute them.

  1. Download from Releases: on Windows bosar-<version>-win-x64-setup.exe (per-user install, no administrator needed; tick "Add the bosar command line to the user PATH" in the wizard), on macOS bosar-<version>-mac-arm64.dmg (Apple silicon only; on first launch right-click → Open, or xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Bosar.app).
  2. Open a new terminal (so PATH takes effect) and check the version and environment:
bosar version                      # with the build id: bosar 0.4.0b0 (build 2026…-win-x64 …)
bosar preflight --offline          # P305 shows the build record; P401 reports SNAPHU as "no CS2 solver (MST init)"
  1. With no data at all, run the demo first (a synthetic pair of images, project creation, import, the full DInSAR chain, about a minute):
bosar demo my_demo                 # 8 steps done; my_demo/project is an ordinary project that opens in the GUI
bosar-gui my_demo/project          # or open Bosar from the Start menu / Applications
  1. Machines with an NVIDIA GPU: the GPU is a plug-in, installed once (about 1.5 GB, CuPy and the CUDA 12 runtime libraries from PyPI, no pip needed):
bosar gpu install                  # or --no-ctk (when a CUDA 12 toolkit is already installed)
bosar preflight --offline          # P202 gpu.plugin ok, P201 gpu.backend shows the graphics card

Apple-silicon Macs have no CUDA; Bosar runs on the CPU (NumPy). 5. From there, the workflow of steps 1–10 is exactly the same on the installed version (bosar project new, bosar data import, bosar pipeline dinsar …); PS-InSAR (the pipeline psi of step 32) and two-scene differential interferometry are included as well. The installed version's SNAPHU has no CS2 solver; unwrapping uses the MST initialisation, which is the default everywhere since 0.4.1 (init: mst in the step summary) and the same optimisation problem started from a different point; if you need MCF initialisation, use the CS2 build from the source checkout (packaging/snaphu/build.ps1) with unwrap.init=mcf. 6. Licence: the "About Bosar" card on the Settings page shows the licence line (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; contact the author for a commercial licence) and three files (Licence… / Notice… / Third-party licences…); the same texts are in _internal/licenses/ in the installation directory.

docs.title: Step 51: ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 reader and JAXA's free samples
docs.text:
bosar fetch slc --mission alos2 --sample list
bosar fetch slc --mission alos2 --sample 730_greenland
bosar project new demo_alos2 --storage-mode full
bosar fetch dem demo_alos2 --bbox -71.5,77.4,-67.0,78.5 --tile-dir data/aux/dem_tiles
bosar pipeline stripmap-coregister demo_alos2 --product data/raw/alos2/ALOS2150521570-170307 --product data/raw/alos2/ALOS2152591570-170321 --reader alos2 --crop-wkt "POLYGON((-70.1 77.85,-69.1 77.85,-69.1 78.05,-70.1 78.05,-70.1 77.85))" --id alos2_pair

ALOS-2 L1.1 CEOS products are read by the same ceos_alos reader (told apart by the scene id ALOS2…): the mode comes from the product id (the FBS/FBD/FBQ, HBS/HBD/HBQ and UBS/UBD stripmap modes are readable; spotlight SBS and ScanSAR are recognised and refused by name), the 544-byte line prefix carries microsecond time stamps, and the starting slant range is taken from the line headers rather than the leader's range gate (which on ALOS-2 is not the delay to the first sample). JAXA's 22 free sample sets can be fetched by anonymous FTP (--sample list lists them); ASF's ALOS-2 collection currently holds only ScanSAR (30–60 GB per scene). The result of the Greenland FBS pair (2017-03-07 / 03-21, 14 days) through the stripmap coregistration chain is in the v0.4.0 release notes.

docs.title: Bosar 上手手册：从全新克隆到市中心的形变图与损毁代理图
docs.text:
用的是安装版？ 这份手册是在源码检出上写的。用到源码树的步骤（git clone、pip install -e、scripts/...、pytest）需要源码；源码不公开，只按作者的源码许可提供（见 Licensing）。用安装包的读者从 Install 和第 50 步（安装版）开始；其余各步的 bosar 命令就是安装版的命令。

适用版本：v0.1.0-alpha.1（第 1 阶段结束）。这份手册回答"软件现在做到哪一步"： 每一条命令都在写手册时逐字运行过，完整输出在 发布说明。没有图形界面， 所有操作都在 PowerShell 里完成。

目标：在 Indianapolis 市中心 7.2 × 10.8 km 的裁剪区上，从 SNAP 导出的 GAMMA/StaMPS 栈出发， 得到地理编码的视线向形变图 geo_disp、相干变化的损毁代理图 geo_dpm、幅度对数比与 RGB 合成图， 再把它们裁到高速公路两侧 500 m 的范围导出成 COG + GeoPackage。整个过程在 CPU 上约 8 分钟， 其中大部分是第 2 步的 pip 安装；处理本身不到 2 分钟。

docs.title: 第 0 步：按你的机器修改这三个变量（唯一需要改的地方）
docs.text:
$DATA = "<data-root>"                  # 只读数据池（本手册只读取，不写入）
$MAIN = "<repo>"       # 已经编译过 SNAPHU 的主工作目录
$WORK = "<repo>\data\walkthrough_bosar"   # 放新克隆的位置

$DATA 下用到的文件：GAMMA 栈 01_Preprocessed\01_IW2\、原始 zip 00_RawData\S1A_IW_SLC__1SDV_20240821T..._E05B.zip（只读几何注释，不解压）、高速公路线 04_GIS\indianapolis_highways.geojson、GACOS 文件夹 05_Auxiliary\00_GACOS\。

docs.title: 第 1 步：克隆代码
docs.text:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $WORK | Out-Null
Set-Location $WORK
git -c safe.directory=* clone --quiet $MAIN bosar_walk
Set-Location bosar_walk
git -c safe.directory=* log --oneline -1

克隆来自第 0 步的主工作副本（$MAIN）；GitHub 上的公开仓库只放文档和安装包，不放源码。拿到源码仓库地址的读者把它换到 $MAIN 的位置。在不记录文件所有者的 磁盘上，git 会对新克隆报 "dubious ownership"（退出码 128）；上面这条命令只对这一次放行，不改你的全局配置。 想长期放行，可以自己执行 git config --global --add safe.directory <克隆目录>。

docs.title: 第 2 步：建立 Python 环境
docs.text:
python -m venv .venv
.\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
python -m pip install --quiet -e ".[dev,unwrap,viz]"
python --version
  • unwrap 装 scikit-image（没有 SNAPHU 时的解缠后备），viz 装 matplotlib（快视图）。
  • 有 NVIDIA 显卡时再装 python -m pip install -e ".[gpu]"，软件自动用 CuPy；本手册不装， 全部在 CPU 上跑（preflight 会提示 W401，属正常）。

docs.title: 第 3 步：开发环境变量
docs.text:
. .\scripts\dev_env.ps1

把 ruff / pytest / CuPy 的缓存都放进仓库内的 .cache\，并提醒：同一时间只应有一个使用 GPU 的进程（跑流水线时不要同时跑完整测试）。

docs.title: 第 4 步：自检 preflight
docs.text:
bosar version
bosar preflight

逐项检查 Python、依赖、GPU、磁盘、SNAPHU 等；OK 通过、WARN 可以继续、FAIL 会阻止运行。 全新克隆里还没有 SNAPHU 可执行文件，P401 显示 WARN（W501：会退回 scikit-image）。

docs.title: 第 5 步：放入 SNAPHU
docs.text:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force packaging\bin\win-x64 | Out-Null
Copy-Item "$MAIN\packaging\bin\win-x64\snaphu.exe" packaging\bin\win-x64\
bosar preflight | Select-String "P401"

SNAPHU 2.0.6 由 packaging\snaphu\build.ps1 用 MinGW-w64 编译；它和 author 在 WSL 里跑的 SNAPHU 对同样输入给出逐像素相同的结果。 二进制文件不进 git（许可证与平台原因），所以新克隆要从主目录复制或自己编译。复制后 P401 为 OK。

docs.title: 第 6 步：新建项目
docs.text:
bosar project new walk --name walk_demo --storage-mode full

项目就是一个文件夹：project.json（步骤、参数、产品清单）、products\、logs\、scratch\。 full 保留全部中间产品（便于查看）；默认的 minimal 会在链结束后删除可再生的中间文件。

docs.title: 第 7 步：从全栈裁出市中心
docs.text:
bosar data crop "$DATA\01_Preprocessed\01_IW2" --window 7904,8672,2590,5662 --dates 20240704,20240821,20240902,20240914,20250723 --annotation "$DATA\00_RawData\S1A_IW_SLC__1SDV_20240821T234025_20240821T234052_055318_06BEBA_E05B.zip" --out data\indy_downtown_crop

从 12239 × 25925 的 IW2 栈里按窗口读出 768 × 3072 像素、5 个日期（只读，窗口读取，不载入整景）， 写成本仓库 data\ 下的 GeoTIFF + crop.json。--annotation 直接从原始 zip 里读 SAFE 注释， 把 SNAP 导出里的名义几何（距离向 2 m、地球半径小 11.5 km）改成真实值（2.33 m 等）， crop.json 里记 I201。

docs.title: 第 8 步：导入裁剪区和全栈
docs.text:
bosar data import walk data\indy_downtown_crop
bosar data import walk "$DATA\01_Preprocessed\01_IW2" --annotation "$DATA\00_RawData\S1A_IW_SLC__1SDV_20240821T234025_20240821T234052_055318_06BEBA_E05B.zip"
bosar project info walk

导入只登记元数据（日期、几何、基线、足迹），原始数据留在原地。全栈 29 景，20240821_20240704 的 B⊥ 从名义几何的 223.8 m 校正为 213.9 m（SNAP 自己给 216.1 m）。项目里有两个栈，后面的流水线 用 --stack 指明。

docs.title: 第 9 步：DInSAR 流水线 → geo_disp
docs.text:
bosar pipeline dinsar walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --all-pairs --looks 2,10 --backend snaphu --geocode-coh

每一对干涉图依次运行：ifg_import（引用栈里的差分干涉图）→ multilook（2 × 10 视，28 × 23 m） → coherence（DInSAR v0.1.0 起默认用 slc-box 配方：全分辨率 5 × 5 窗口，再在 2 × 10 块里平均， 与 MintPy 的相干一致；--recipe looks 是标准估计，每个多视块 20 个样本。CCD 则默认 looks，见第 11 步）→ goldstein（滤波） → unwrap（SNAPHU， 单块）→ geocode_unw → displacement（d = −λφ/4π，米，朝向卫星为正，参考点为 0）→ geocode_disp → geocode_coh。屏幕上每行一步，最后一行是运行日志的位置。 四对共 36 步，CPU 上约 25 秒（结果与 GPU 一致到 1e-6）。

docs.title: 第 10 步：看快视图
docs.text:
Get-ChildItem walk\products\figure -Name | Select-Object -First 12
  • *_coherence.png：相干（黑 0 → 白 1），河道、植被暗，建筑、道路亮。
  • *_unwrapped.png：解缠相位（弧度，红蓝对称）。
  • *_displacement.png：视线向形变（毫米，红 = 朝向卫星，蓝 = 远离卫星，色标取 2–98 % 对称）， 12–48 天的短对上主要是大气（厘米级），不是地面沉降。
  • geo_* 产品（walk\products\geo_disp\ 等）是 EPSG:4326 的 GeoTIFF，可直接拖进 QGIS。

docs.title: 第 11 步：相干变化检测 → geo_dpm
docs.text:
bosar pipeline ccd walk --pre 20240821_20240902 20240821_20240914 --co 20240821_20240704
bosar pipeline ccd walk --pre 20240821_20240902 20240821_20240914 --co 20240821_20250723

--pre 是事件前的两对（夏季，12/24 天），--co 是"事件"对。没有真实的破坏事件，所以： 第一条是空检验（同一季节的另一对）；第二条是季节伪事件（336 天，跨过冬季）。实测结果 （用的是标准估计 looks，详见发布说明）：按分位阈值 2 % 超阈、去斑点后约 0.36 % 留在图上；但两种情况的图 都集中在相干的城区目标上，而不是植被——在 C 波段 12/24 天的夏季对里，农田和林地在事件前就已经 失相干，没有可失去的相干，所以审查预期的像土地覆盖图这种失效方式在这批数据上不会出现。空检验也 不是纯噪声：48 天的事件对本身比 12/24 天的事件前对更失相干，固定阈值 z ≥ 3 会标出约 5 %。产品：ccd_delta（相干下降量）、ccd_z（按事件前各对之间的离散度标准化，正 = 下降）、 dpm（1 = 显著下降，0 = 无，255 = 事件前相干 < 0.3 被屏蔽），以及地理编码的 geo_ccd、geo_dpm。 人工注入的 200 m 损毁块能被检出（测试 tests/test_ccd.py，looks 下精度与召回 ≥ 0.9）。 两种相干配方的取舍：slc-box 方位向 5 行的窗口大于 2 视，相邻多视像素共用样本， ccd_z 在空间上相关（空检验的 Moran's I 约 0.37，looks 下 < 0.1），损毁块边缘会多标出一圈像素（召回 仍为 1，精度约 0.72）——偏差小但边界发虚；looks 像素彼此独立、边界清晰，低相干处偏差略大。做损毁 制图时定位比偏差更要紧，所以 pipeline ccd 和界面的 CCD 工作流默认 looks（DInSAR 仍默认 slc-box）。如果 CCD 读到的是 slc-box 相干，日志里会记一条 W106 说明；想用它就显式加 --recipe slc-box（新算的相干步骤建议加 --tag，两套结果并存）。

docs.title: 第 12 步：幅度变化（对数比与 RGB）
docs.text:
bosar run walk amplitude --step-id amplitude_crop --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --looks 2,10
bosar run walk log_ratio --step-id log_ratio_20240821_20250723 --requires amplitude_crop --pre 20240821 --post 20250723
bosar run walk rgb_composite --step-id rgb_20240821_20250723 --requires amplitude_crop --pre 20240821 --post 20250723
bosar run walk geocode --step-id geocode_log_ratio_20240821_20250723 --requires amplitude_crop --requires log_ratio_20240821_20250723 --source log_ratio

GAMMA 栈没有辐射定标，所以幅度变化是相对的：每个日期先在"稳定散射体"（幅度离散度最低的 95 % 像素）上归一化，再算 10·log10(I_后/I_前)（正 = 变亮）。RGB 合成里红 = 事前、绿蓝 = 事后： 红色是变暗，青色是变亮，灰色是不变。定标查找表（σ⁰）已经能直接从原始 zip 读出（33 个 zip 全部可读）， 在 v0.2.0 的原生 SAFE 流程里使用。

docs.title: 第 13 步：导出（裁到高速公路两侧 500 m）
docs.text:
bosar export walk all --aoi "$DATA\04_GIS\indianapolis_highways.geojson" --buffer-m 500 --out walk\export
Get-Content walk\export\README.txt -TotalCount 25

每个地理编码产品写成一个云优化 GeoTIFF（COG），高速公路 500 m 以外设为无数据；矢量（产品范围、 参考点、AOI、栈足迹）写进一个 GeoPackage；README.txt 和 export.json 写明每个文件的单位、 符号约定、参考点、日期对和运行编号。

docs.title: 第 14 步：日志在哪里、怎么看
docs.text:
bosar logs walk --tail 3
Get-ChildItem walk\logs -Name | Select-Object -Last 3

每次运行一个 logs\run_*.jsonl（每行一条 JSON，UTC 时间精确到微秒，含参数、输入、输出、用时、 峰值内存），旁边是给人看的 .log 和 Markdown 报告 .md。bosar logs walk --failure 显示 最近一次失败的原因和提示。

docs.title: 第 15 步：GACOS 申请卡与已有文件的校验
docs.text:
bosar aux gacos-request walk --stack gamma_01_IW2
bosar aux gacos-check walk --stack gamma_01_IW2 --dir "$DATA\05_Auxiliary\00_GACOS"

GACOS 没有 API：软件根据项目算出要填进 gacos.net 表单的范围（N/W/E/S）、时间（23:40 UTC，来自 SAFE 的 startTime，而不是 SNAP 导出 par 里被减半的 11:50）、日期（每次最多 20 个，29 个分两次）， 你提交表单、收到邮件后把 .ztd/.rsc 放进 walk\aux\gacos\，再用 gacos-check 校验。 <data-root> 里已有的 29 个日期全部通过（时间差 0.4 分钟、边缘余量 0.10°、无缺值）。 对流层改正本身在 v0.2.0 加入。

docs.title: 第 16 步：图形界面
docs.text:
同一个 PowerShell 窗口里（虚拟环境和 dev_env.ps1 都已生效）启动图形界面：

bosar gui walk

也可以直接运行 bosar-gui walk（不带控制台窗口的启动器）。这一步在上面的自动核对里不执行，因为 窗口会一直开着；关掉窗口即结束。界面的设置（主题、最近的项目、SNAPHU 路径等）存在 $env:BOSAR_CONFIG_DIR 指向的 INI 文件里（开发环境是仓库内的 .cache\config），不写注册表。

图形界面不做任何计算：每一个操作都是一条 bosar … 命令，显示在窗口底部的命令条里，可以一键 复制到 PowerShell 执行，结果与上面第 6–15 步完全相同；处理在单独的进程里运行，界面读取的是同一个 project.json 和 logs\run_*.jsonl。

  • Project：新建 / 打开项目，摘要卡片列出数据栈、步骤状态和各级产品的占用空间。
  • Check：第 4 步的 preflight，按系统 / GPU / 依赖 / 程序 / 凭据 / 网络 / 项目分组，绿黄红三色。
  • Data：数据集表、基线表（Δt 与 B⊥ 按阈值着色）、基线网络图、Natural Earth 底图上的数据栈足迹， 选中日期时显示该日期的幅度图；把栈文件夹拖进来即可导入（第 8 步）。
  • Run：选流程（DInSAR / CCD / 幅度变化）、选像对，参数表由各步骤的参数定义自动生成（常用项在上， 其余在"Advanced"里），右边实时显示将要运行的那条命令；Run 启动，Stop 先请求取消（当前步骤 记为 cancelled），5 秒内没有停下再结束整个进程树（包括 SNAPHU）。

  • View：左边是产品树，右边两个可联动的图像视图；色表按产品类型固定（相干灰度 0–1、形变红蓝对称、 单位 mm，红 = 朝向卫星），鼠标下方显示全分辨率的数值、单位和经纬度；可叠加损毁代理图，可导出 （第 13 步的 bosar export）。

  • Logs：每次运行一行，记录表可按级别 / 事件 / 步骤 / 文字筛选；失败的运行显示失败卡片： WHAT（错误码与信息）、WHERE（步骤、代码位置、文件）、HINT（怎么办）、LOG（日志文件与行号）。

  • Aux：第 15 步的 GACOS 申请卡，每个字段都有复制按钮，"Copy request k" 按网站表单的顺序复制一批 日期；放文件的文件夹一有变化就自动重新校验。轨道和 DEM 的卡片在 v0.2.0 启用。
  • Settings（右上角齿轮）：主题（深色 / 浅色 / 跟随系统）、计算设备（自动 / CPU / GPU）、SNAPHU 路径、新项目的存储模式、只读数据目录；凭据只显示有没有，从不显示内容。

docs.title: 第 17 步：账号凭据
docs.text:
凭据只走两条路：终端里 bosar auth set <service>（隐藏输入，或 --from-file 你的文件.txt，文件 只读一次不复制），或者图形界面 Settings → Credentials → Set…（先提示注册、说明去哪里找 key、 再填写或"从文件导入"）。值存进系统凭据库（Windows 凭据管理器 / macOS 钥匙串），从不出现在命令行、 日志和交付包里。看状态：

bosar auth status
bosar auth services

这几步用到的下载都不需要账号：轨道走本地文件夹和 SNAP 缓存，缺的走 ASF 公开镜像；DEM 走 AWS 公开桶。 cdse（Copernicus Data Space）账号是可选的加速来源。

docs.title: 第 18 步：轨道文件——先找本地，再下载
docs.text:
bosar fetch orbits walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --local-dir <data-root>/05_Auxiliary/03_Orbits --no-download

每个日期挑一个覆盖采集时刻（±60 s）的 POEORB（没有才用 RESORB），先在 --local-dir（会记进 project.json）、BOSAR_ORBIT_DIRS 和 SNAP 的缓存 ~/.snap/auxdata/Orbits/Sentinel-1 里找，找到的 原地引用并记 sha256；缺的日期去掉 --no-download 就会下载到 walk/aux/orbits/。项目里有两个栈 （裁剪栈和整幅栈），所以要用 --stack 指明；这个裁剪栈的 5 个日期在本地全部命中，0 下载。

docs.title: 第 19 步：DEM——本地瓦片拼接，默认椭球高
docs.text:
bosar fetch dem walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --tile-dir <data-root>/05_Auxiliary/02_DEM/tiles --no-download

按栈的足迹加 0.1° 找 1°×1° 的 GLO-30 瓦片，本地齐全就直接拼接（不联网），写到 walk/aux/dem/glo30_<W>_<S>_<E>_<N>.tif 和同名 .json（用了哪些瓦片、sha256、大地水准面模型）。 默认 椭球高（GLO-30 是 EGM2008 正高，程序加上大地水准面差距，这里约 −33 m）；--height orthometric 保留正高。

docs.title: 第 20 步：快速相干预览与用轨道算基线
docs.text:
bosar data preview walk --pair 20240821_20240914
bosar data baselines walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --from-orbits

预览几秒钟给出一对的粗相干图（walk/preview/coh_<pair>.tif，带 Δt 与 B⊥），界面里在 Data 页选中 一对按 Preview coherence。--from-orbits 用第 18 步的轨道在 10×10 个目标上算 B⊥/B∥，和 .base 里的 TCN 值逐对比较，没有 .base 的对补上（method orbit）。裁剪栈的 4 对差都在 3 m 以内；对整幅栈 gamma_01_IW2（29 期）跑同一条命令，25 对里 21 对差 1 m 以内。

docs.title: 第 21 步：GACOS 大气改正（--tropo gacos）
docs.text:
bosar pipeline dinsar walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --pair 20240821_20240914 --looks 2,10 --backend snaphu --tropo gacos --gacos-dir <data-root>/05_Auxiliary/00_GACOS --tag gacos

在 unwrap 之后多一步 tropo_gacos：每个像素在两个日期的 ZTD 网格上双线性取值，除以该像素入射角的 余弦得斜距延迟，φ_tropo = 4π/λ (S_sec − S_ref)（次影像延迟更大 = 距离变长 = 相位为正）， unw_tropo = unw − φ_tropo（参考点保持 0），displacement 改用 unw_tropo。步骤摘要里有改正前后 相干像素的位移 RMS（这一对 6.25 → 5.09 mm；整幅 IW2 同一对 30.2 → 22.3 mm）。缺哪个日期的文件、时刻 对不上或网格不覆盖，步骤会报 E201/E204 并说明是哪个日期哪个文件。bosar aux status walk --for dinsar+gacos 提前列出缺什么、哪些能自动取（给出命令）、哪些要你动手。

docs.title: 第 22 步：SBAS 网络设计
docs.text:
bosar sbas network walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --max-dt 400 --max-bperp 300 --k 2 --name crop

按 Δt / |B⊥| 阈值选对，再给每个日期补 --k 条按时间最近的连接（跨越空档也能连通），报告连通分量、 冗余度（对数 / 日期数）和三元环数；被拒绝的对连同原因一起记进 project.json（aux.sbas.networks）。 你自己的 network_design.csv 可以用 --from-csv 导入（B⊥ 以栈里的轨道基线为准）。裁剪栈 5 个日期： 9 对、1 对被拒（|B⊥| 392 m 但作为顺序连接保留）、7 个三元环、连通。界面里在 Run 页选 SBAS prep， 可以直接设计网络、看网络图（选中的对实线、被拒的对虚线）。

docs.title: 第 23 步：派生小基线干涉图、公共参考点、批量解缠
docs.text:
bosar sbas prep walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --network crop --looks 2,10 --backend snaphu --workers 3 --nproc 2 --tag sbas

步骤 id 带网络名（coherence_<对>_crop_sbas），同一项目里两个栈的网络互不干扰。四个可续跑的阶段：prepare——每对 ifg_derive → multilook → coherence（ifg_derive 用星形栈 diff(ref,i)、diff(ref,j) 与参考影像功率算出平地化的 (i, j) 对，相干用同一分子和两景 SLC 功率）； reference——所有对里都相干（≥ 0.3）的像元中平均相干最高的那个当公共参考点（写进网络记录）； unwrap——每对 SNAPHU（smooth 代价）、统一参考；closure——见下一步。--workers 3 让三对并行 （子进程，CPU），project.json 的并发写入靠修订号合并。裁剪区 9 对：prepare 约 1 分钟/对， unwrap 1–3 秒/对，参考像元 (20, 167)。

docs.title: 第 24 步：三元环闭合（B4）
docs.text:
sbas prep 的最后一步就是 closure；也可以单独跑：

bosar sbas prep walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --network crop --phase closure --looks 2,10 --tag sbas

每个闭合三角算两样：缠绕相位闭合 arg(c_ij c_jk conj(c_ik))（相位偏差）和解缠相位的整数闭合 round((u_ij + u_jk − u_ik − w)/2π)（解缠错误）；产品 closure/wrapped_rms、closure/integer_count， 摘要里有逐三元环、逐对（含"系统性错误"标记）和只看相干像元的统计。裁剪区 7 个三元环：缠绕闭合 RMS 中位数 0.94 rad（三对都相干的像元 0.43–0.52 rad），整数闭合非零的像元占 9–24 %（相干像元 2–11 %；夏季三元环 20240821-0902-0914 最好，2.2 %）。

docs.title: 第 25 步：用 SNAP 做预处理（需要装好 ESA SNAP）
docs.text:
bosar preflight --offline
bosar pipeline preprocess walk --engine snap --product "$DATA\00_RawData\S1A_IW_SLC__1SDV_20240821T234025_20240821T234052_055318_06BEBA_E05B.zip" --product "$DATA\00_RawData\S1A_IW_SLC__1SDV_20240902T234025_20240902T234052_055493_06C53E_B90F.zip" --product "$DATA\00_RawData\S1A_IW_SLC__1SDV_20240914T234026_20240914T234052_055668_06CC28_B2FF.zip" --subswath IW2 --aoi-wkt "POLYGON((-86.30 39.65,-86.00 39.65,-86.00 39.90,-86.30 39.90,-86.30 39.65))" --threads 8 --cache-mb 8192 --tag subset

预检的 P402 报告 SNAP 的 gpt、工具箱和堆内存。命令把 SNAP 当作单独的程序调用（不复制、不导入 SNAP 的代码）：TOPSAR-Split（按 AOI 选 burst）→ Apply-Orbit-File（用第 18 步找到的本地轨道，复制到 walk/snap/userdir）→ Back-Geocoding（外部 DEM = 第 19 步的椭球高拼接，walk/aux/dem）→ ESD → Interferogram（平地 + 地形相位、相干、高程、经纬度）→ Deburst，产品是 BEAM-DIMAP，随后自动导入 （data import --reader dimap --ifg-dim）成栈 snap_subset，第 8 步之后的所有命令都能用它。SNAP 写的每个文件都在 walk/snap/ 和 walk/products/dimap/ 里，~/.snap 一个文件都不动。本机上：栈 90 s、干涉图 344 s、gpt 峰值内存 45 GB（gpt.vmoptions 的 -Xmx132G 允许它这么用）。注意：DEM 只 拼了 AOI 那个框，Back-Geocoding 会把没有高程的像元全部置空，所以子集里只有 AOI 框内有数据。

docs.title: 第 26 步：相干不够时哪些对、哪些像元会被剔除
docs.text:
SBAS 的结果好不好，主要取决于喂进去的解缠相位靠不靠谱。Bosar 把"剔除"做成明确的规则，每一条都 会在命令输出和 project.json 里留下记录，你可以逐条放宽或收紧：

层次 规则 在哪里调 记录在哪里 整对 空对：相干处处为 0（导出里该日期的干涉图或 SLC 全零，导入时报 W206） 不可调 网络记录 empty_pairs 整对 弱对：相干 ≥ 0.4 的像元不到 5 %；但每个日期保留它向前、向后最好的一条连接 sbas prep --min-coherent-fraction 0.05（0 = 不剔除） weak_pairs、weak_pairs_kept、pair_quality 整对 不可靠对：它参与的每一个三元环里，相干像元上整数闭合不为 0 的比例都超过 30 %（整景去相干或配准坏掉的日期） unw_correct --pair-max-error 0.3 unw_correct 摘要的 unreliable_pairs 像元 该对在这个像元的相干低于阈值 pipeline sbas --coh-min 0.3 sbas_invert 摘要 pair_pixels_dropped.coherence 像元 该像元不在参考点所在的解缠连通分量里 --any-component 关闭此规则 pair_pixels_dropped.component 像元 闭合改正之后该对所在的三元环仍不闭合 --keep-unclosed 关闭此规则 pair_pixels_dropped.unclosed_triplet

一个像元至少剩下 2 对才有时间序列（--min-pairs）；只有它的网络把所有日期连成一片、并且时间相干 ≥ 0.7，才进入默认掩膜（产品 ts_mask）。如果整对规则把整个网络断成几段（冬季几对全不可靠时会这样）， sbas_invert 报 W107：各段之间的偏移未知，速度按"同一速率 + 每段一个截距"拟合；想把断口接上， 就多留几条跨越断口的对（sbas network --k 调大、--min-coherent-fraction 调小，或用 sbas_invert --exclude-pairs 自己指定）。网络设计还有两个选项：--sequential-only（只要每个日期 时间上最近的 k 条连接）和 --season-months 5-10（拒绝跨季节的对，顺序连接除外）。

docs.title: 第 27 步：SBAS 时间序列（pipeline sbas）
docs.text:
bosar pipeline sbas walk --network crop --tag sbas --tropo gacos --gacos-dir <data-root>/05_Auxiliary/00_GACOS

在第 23 步准备好的网络上依次做：unw_correct（按闭合环改正 2π 解缠错误，Yunjun 等 2019 的相位闭合 法，按"闭合模式"去重后每种模式只解一次）→ sbas_invert（逐像元网络的加权最小二乘 / 最小范数解， Berardino 等 2002；权来自相干和视数；输出 ts_los（每个日期一个波段，单位 m，朝向卫星为正）、 velocity（m/yr）及其标准差、temporal_coherence、n_pairs_used、ts_rank、ts_mask）→ ts_correct（每个日期的 GACOS 斜距延迟，参考到参考点和参考日期；--deramp 再逐日期去一个平面； --tropo era5 用 ERA5 气压层数据，需要 CDS key）→ 地理编码（速度、时间相干、时间序列）。 产品内部一律是米和米/年，界面、CSV 和摘要里才换成毫米。改正方式写进步骤 id（ts_correct_crop_sbas_gacos）， 所以不改正、GACOS、ERA5 的结果可以并存对比。这个 5 景裁剪只有 9 对，结果只用来演示流程；26 景的 裁剪（data/indy_downtown_ts，见发布说明）才有像样的时间序列。

docs.title: 第 28 步：导出给 MintPy 对比（可选）
docs.text:
bosar sbas export-mintpy walk --network crop --tag sbas --out walk\mintpy

写出 inputs/ifgramStack.h5、inputs/geometryRadar.h5 和一个最小的 smallbaselineApp.cfg（文件 格式按 MintPy 手册写，没有用 MintPy 的代码）。MintPy 作为单独的程序在这些文件上运行 （ifgram_inversion.py inputs/ifgramStack.h5 -w var），就能和 Bosar 在完全相同的输入上对比； --mintpy-legacy-bperp 把基线写成导出里 .base 的值，和你以前那套 MintPy 数据一致。

docs.title: 第 29 步：在界面里看时间序列、叠图层、导出图
docs.text:
bosar gui walk → Results 页：

  • 选中 geo_velocity（速度图）：左下 Layers 面板里选底图（默认“无”——v0.4.0 起发行版不再默认连任何瓦片服务器；Sentinel-2 无云镶嵌 2016 年是 CC BY、可直接用，OpenStreetMap、Esri 各有使用条款，自定义 XYZ 在 Settings 里填模板、密钥与署名），可以把底图调暗；每个图层有显示开关、0–100 % 的 透明度（底图上默认 70 %）、上下顺序、"相干 / 时间相干低于阈值处透明"的掩膜；"Add selected as layer" 把树里选中的另一个地理编码产品叠上来。雷达几何的产品不会被偷偷重投影，而是给一个 "Geocode for the map" 按钮去跑 geocode 步骤。
  • 在速度图上点像元：下方出现该像元的 LOS 位移时间序列（毫米）和线性拟合、速率（mm/yr）；可以点多个 像元、勾选不同改正（未改正 / GACOS / ERA5）、导出 CSV；雷达几何视图里参考点用星号标出。
  • "Export view…" 把当前视图存成 PNG 或 PDF：带色标、每个图层一行图例、比例尺、指北针和底图署名， 生成各图层的命令写在文件元数据里。

docs.title: 第 30 步：结果能不能用？——质量判定和数据体检
docs.text:
bosar sbas quality walk --network crop --tag sbas

每条时间序列链（pipeline sbas、pipeline psds）跑完都会打印一个质量判定： USABLE（可用）/ MARGINAL（勉强，只能在说明的限制内读）/ NOT USABLE（不能当形变解读）。 判定来自实测指标，每条都带警告码、实测值、门槛和具体的补救办法：

警告码 指标 勉强 不可用 W108 连通且时间相干达标的像元占比 < 20 % < 2 % W109 被剔除的干涉对占比，或整天丢失的日期 > 30 % 或有日期丢失 — W107 网络断成几段 是 — W110 可用像元的速度离散度 > 4 mm/yr > 10 mm/yr W111 改正后仍不闭合的三元环占比 > 15 % — W112 速度中位数相对参考点明显偏离（场景斜坡或参考点本身有问题） 是 — W113 相邻两期之间出现接近半个波长的跳变的像元占比（并指出从哪天开始） > 3 % —

bosar sbas quality 还会打印逐日期的数据体检表：每个日期有几对、多少是空的（全零）、多少太弱、 多少被闭合检查判为不可靠、平均相干像元占比。所有对都是空的日期是数据问题（那一景在导出里就是空的， 调参数没用，只能重新配准或剔除）；所有对都失败的日期是那天失相干（雪、雨、落叶）。界面里结果页会在 地图上方用横幅显示同样的判定。

docs.title: 第 31 步：PS / DS 时间序列（pipeline psds）
docs.text:
bosar pipeline psds walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --strides 2,10 --workers 3 --backend snaphu

植被多的地方多视 SBAS 留不下多少像元。这条链改用两类散射体：分布式散射体（DS）——在每个像元周围 找统计上同质的邻居（SHP，幅度的 GLRT 检验），在这些邻居上估 N×N 的相干矩阵，再用相位联合（EMI） 一次估出 N 个日期的相位；永久散射体（PS）——幅度离差 D_A ≤ 0.25 的点保留自己的相位。两者合成 一个"混合栈"，再走第 23–27 步同样的解缠、闭合、反演。依次是：slc_flatten（用 Bosar 自己的平地相位 把每景 SLC 去平；同时扫描每个日期，有一条缺失带的日期会被检出并默认剔除，W207）→ psds_link （SHP、相位联合、PS 选择；GPU 上 26 景 768×3072 只要十几秒）→ 每对的干涉图 → 解缠 → 闭合改正 → 反演 → 地理编码 → 质量判定。常用选项：--shp glrt|ks、--method emi|evd、--ps-da 0.25、 --strides 方位,距离（输出网格的抽稀）、--ds-tcoh 0.6（DS 需要的相位联合时间相干；纯噪声在这个栈上 最高只有 0.36）、--keep-partial-dates。5 景的裁剪只用来演示流程（日期太少，相位联合意义不大）； 26 景测试区的结果见发布说明。

docs.title: 第 32 步：经典 PS-InSAR 作为独立对照（pipeline psi）
docs.text:
bosar pipeline psi walk --stack crop_indy_downtown_crop --name psds --max-arc-m 3000

按 Ferretti 等 2001 / Kampes 2006 重新实现的经典 PSI，不做相位联合也不做空间解缠：PS 候选点 （D_A）→ Delaunay 三角网的边 → 每条边用周期图同时估高程误差和速率（一次矩阵乘法批量算）→ 从参考点沿 最相干的路径积分 → 由残差估大气相位屏并扣除 → 每个点最终估计。结果是一个 GeoPackage 点图层 （products/psi_points/）：LOS 速度（朝向卫星为正）、高程误差、时间相干和每个日期的位移。验收门槛会 按这个栈的日期数自动抬到"纯噪声的 99 分位"之上（日期少时噪声也能凑出很高的时间相干）。它复用上一步 slc_flatten_psds 的去平栈。

docs.title: 第 33 步：在界面里看 PS/DS 结果
docs.text: bosar gui walk → Run 页选 PS / DS time series 可以直接跑上面的命令；Results 页选中 PS/DS 的 速度图后，勾选 PS points 会把永久散射体画成点（颜色 = 速度，大小 = 质量），点一下看它的时间序列； psds_temporal_coherence、shp_count、psds_type、amp_dispersion 这几张质量图都可以直接看。网络 断成几段时，时间序列按段分别画线、每段一个偏移量（段与段之间的位移未知）。

docs.title: 第 34 步：从 ASF 下载原始 SLC（fetch slc）
docs.text:
bosar fetch slc --project demo_dinsar --stack gamma_01_IW2 --range 2025-08-01:2026-09-30 --dry-run
bosar fetch slc --project demo_dinsar --stack gamma_01_IW2 --range 2025-08-01:2026-09-30 --range 2023-07-01:2024-06-30 --dest data/raw/s1 --detach
bosar fetch status --dest data/raw/s1
bosar fetch stop --dest data/raw/s1

按栈的相对轨道、帧和足迹（或 --aoi "POINT(lon lat)" + --relative-orbit）在 ASF 搜索景，--dry-run 只列清单和大小；真下载是 Bosar 自己的循环：断点续传（Range）、按大小和 MD5 校验、每景一个 <name>.json 来源记录、剩余空间低于 --min-free-gb（默认 150 GB）就停、第二批只有剩余空间大于 --continue-if-free-gb 才开始。--detach 让它在后台跑、跨会话继续；进度文件 fetch_slc_progress.json 和 fetch_slc.log 在目标目录。Earthdata 凭据走 ~/.netrc 或钥匙串，不经 聊天。Aux 页有同样的卡片。目标目录拒绝只读的数据根。

docs.title: 第 35 步：原生 TOPS 配准——不经 SNAP 从 zip 到栈（pipeline s1-coregister）
docs.text:
bosar project new demo_native
bosar fetch dem demo_native --bbox -86.52,39.27,-85.06,40.28 --margin-deg 0
bosar pipeline s1-coregister demo_native --product <zip1> --product <zip2> --product <zip3> --subswath IW2 --pol VV --aoi-wkt "POLYGON((-86.30 39.65,-86.00 39.65,-86.00 39.90,-86.30 39.90,-86.30 39.65))" --tag r11
bosar fetch orbits demo_native --stack native_r11 --no-download
bosar run demo_native slc_flatten --step-id slc_flatten_r11 --stack native_r11

第一个 zip 是参考。一步做完：把子条带的注记和影像从 zip 解到 cache/safe/（一次）、从注记建 burst 模型、 精密轨道（项目里记录的，否则数据根 / SNAP 缓存，再否则注记星历并给 W301）、每个参考 burst 在格网上 用 DEM 做 topo、每个副影像 burst 去斜（deramp）→ 按轨道 + DEM 的偏移量做 Knab 窗 sinc 重采样 → 加回 斜坡（reramp）、burst 重叠区做 ESD 并迭代到 0.001 行以内、按重叠中线拼接（deburst），写成 ISCE merged/ 布局（--output cint16 省一半空间）并自动导入成栈 native_<tag>。RTX 3090 上一个 1500 × 25000 的 burst 不到 1 秒（CPU 55 秒）。products/native/stack/<step>.json 记录 burst 参数、 拼接方案、每个日期的 ESD 表与偏移量、耗时。与 SNAP 在同三景上的比对（scripts/validate_native_tops.py、 scripts/validate_native_flat.py）见发布说明。

docs.title: 第 36 步：导入时的空景体检与分波段质量阈值
docs.text: bosar data import 现在对每个日期做抽样扫描（每 128 行读 16 行），全零的日期给 W206、比"公共底数" （所有日期都为零的区域——景边缘、burst 缝隙——取各日期零比例的最小值，W208）多出 2 个百分点以上的 给 W207，并记在栈记录的 warnings 和每个日期记录的 zero_fraction / partially_empty / empty 里； 时间序列链默认仍会剔除 W207 的日期。质量判定按波段选阈值：C 波段默认，L 波段草案（毫米量级的阈值按 波长比放大），输出第二行写明 thresholds: C-band (default)。

docs.title: 第 37 步：界面里的经典 PSI 与点图层
docs.text: bosar gui walk → Run 页多了 Classic PS-InSAR (periodogram)（对应第 32 步的命令，D_A、点数、最长 边、时间相干作为基本参数，计划里是 slc_flatten_psi + psi_classic_psi）；Results 页选中一个 PSI 的结果后勾选 PS points，GeoPackage 里的点会按速度着色、按时间相干定大小地画出来，与 PS/DS 的 点图层同一套机制。

docs.title: 第 38 步：多年原生栈——目录里所有 zip、按 AOI 裁剪、可续跑
docs.text:
bosar project new demo_multi
bosar fetch dem demo_multi --bbox -86.52,39.27,-85.06,40.28 --margin-deg 0
bosar fetch orbits demo_multi --product <参考 zip> --product <其余 zip…>
bosar pipeline s1-coregister demo_multi --product <参考 zip> --products-from <data-root>/00_RawData --products-from data/raw/s1 --subswath IW2 --aoi-wkt "POLYGON((-86.30 39.65,-86.00 39.65,-86.00 39.90,-86.30 39.90,-86.30 39.65))" --crop-wkt "POLYGON((-86.245 39.692,-86.078 39.692,-86.078 39.813,-86.245 39.813,-86.245 39.692))" --drop-cache --tag multi
bosar pipeline psds demo_multi --stack native_multi --workers 6 --tropo era5 --ref-latlon 39.7684,-86.1581 --no-correct --keep-unclosed
bosar pipeline psi demo_multi --stack native_multi --name psds --max-arc-m 3000

--products-from 把文件夹里所有 S1?_IW_SLC__*.zip 按日期排进来（S1A、S1D 一视同仁）；burst 由 AOI 多边形与每个 burst 足迹求交选出；--crop-wkt 只把多边形外接框那一块写盘（burst 仍整块配准）。 一次只处理一个日期：打开 → 去斜 → 几何偏移 → 距离向互相关检查 → ESD → 拼接 → 写盘 → 关闭， 内存不随日期数增长；每个日期写一个 merged/SLC/<date>/coreg.json（设置的签名），再跑同一条命令 只处理新下载的日期（摘要里的 n_reused）。默认输出 CINT16（--output cfloat 可换回）。 fetch orbits --product 在还没有栈的时候按产品名取精密轨道。53 个日期（2024-07 至 2026-07， 含 2 景 S1D）在 RTX 3090 上每景约 53 秒。质量判定第三行给出"实测速度离散 vs 由日期数和时间跨度 预期的离散"：sigma_v = sigma_d * sqrt(12 (N-1) / (N (N+1))) / T。 长栈（两年、近 200 对）上要加 --no-correct --keep-unclosed：闭合改正步骤在这么大的网络上会把 解缠结果改坏（待修），不闭合的对保留下来由时间相干去判定。这样两年数据上 PS/DS 判定 USABLE（26.5 % 的像元可靠，速度离散 1.45 mm/yr，预期 1.1），经典 PSI 也是 USABLE（1.26 mm/yr）， 两条链在可靠像元上相差 0.4–0.6 mm/yr。跨相干缺口（比如河两岸）的相对速度不要读。时间序列项目 建议用 bosar project new --storage-mode full 创建。

docs.title: 第 39 步：定标与地形展平（--calibration、--terrain-flatten）
docs.text:
bosar pipeline s1-coregister demo_native --product <zip1> --product <zip2> --subswath IW2 --bursts 6,8 --output cfloat --calibration sigma0 --terrain-flatten --tag cal
bosar pipeline amplitude demo_native --stack native_cal --pre 20240821 --post 20240902

SLC 保持 DN 不变；merged/calibrated/<date>/<date>.sigma0.rdr（或 beta0 / gamma0）是用 SAFE 定标 LUT 算出的线性功率，gamma0_flat.rdr = beta0 × 面积因子（Small 2011，因子在雷达几何里由 DEM 小面元算出， 平地上等于 tan(入射角)，叠掩和阴影置 NaN），因子本身在 geom_reference/gamma_flat_factor.rdr。 原生栈带定标层时，振幅变化链自动改用绝对后向散射（dB (sigma0)，不再做相对归一化）。 与 SNAP 的 Calibration / Terrain-Flattening 的比对：scripts/validate_native_cal.py。

docs.title: 第 40 步：三个子条带与条带拼接（--subswath IW1,IW2,IW3）
docs.text:
bosar project new demo_full
bosar fetch dem demo_full --bbox -87.65,38.40,-84.001,40.75 --margin-deg 0
bosar pipeline s1-coregister demo_full --product <zip1> --product <zip2> --subswath IW1,IW2,IW3 --tag full --id native_full

三个子条带各配准一次（步骤 s1_coregister_full_iw1…3，不给 --bursts / --aoi-wkt 就是全部 burst），然后 s1_swath_merge_full 把三个栈并到一张距离 / 方位网格上：整像素放置（与 ISCE2 相同）、 重叠区中线切割、不做任何插值，几何层同样拼接，所以每个像素带着自己的经纬度。摘要里的 seams 给出每条接缝、每个日期的相位台阶、相干和幅度台阶。DEM 镶嵌图按窗口读取，整景也不会整幅进内存。

docs.title: 第 41 步：电离层分频估计（iono_split）
docs.text:
bosar run demo_full slc_flatten --step-id slc_flatten_full --stack native_full
bosar run demo_full iono_split --step-id iono_full --requires slc_flatten_full --pair 20240821_20240902

在去平地后的 SLC 栈上：把距离向频谱的上下三分之一各取出来做子带干涉图，只解缠全带一次， 由两个子带相位算出色散项（Gomba 2016），按相干加权做高斯低通。输出 iono_phase/<pair>（载频处的 电离层相位，弧度，多视网格）；摘要里有改正前后解缠相位的平面斜率。噪声放大约 120 倍，所以默认 64 × 256 视。常数项不可定（与所有干涉相位一样是相对量）。

docs.title: 第 42 步：界面——Coregister 工作流与下载批次
docs.text: bosar gui demo_multi → Run 页的 Coregister (Bosar)：Engine 选 bosar（原生链，对应第 38 步的 命令）或 snap（第 25 步的 SNAP 桥接），勾选"all three sub-swaths"就是第 40 步，表单里有输出类型、 定标和地形展平。Aux 页的 Sentinel-1 SLC scenes (ASF) 卡片现在列出每一批的进度、正在传输的 文件和按最近一分钟速率估计的剩余时间；bosar fetch slc --parallel 3 并行下载，网络中断的景在 之后的尝试里自动重试。

docs.title: 第 43 步：时间参考日期与离群日期
docs.text:
bosar pipeline sbas demo_multi --network psds --no-correct --ref-latlon 39.7684,-86.1581 --tropo era5
bosar pipeline sbas demo_multi --network psds --tag ex5 --no-correct --ref-latlon 39.7684,-86.1581 --fit huber --exclude-dates 20230803,20240330,20240622,20250325,20250816

不给 --ref-date 时，序列的零日期不再是第一景，而是"共模中位数"规则：每个日期取好像元的空间 中位数（整景一起相对参考像元动的量，多半是大气），选最接近这些中位数之中位数的那个日期——永远不是 离群日。摘要里记 ref_date_rule、common_mode_mm。W117 点名"偏离拟合直线超过 3 倍稳健标准差且 超过 20 % 像元"的日期；--exclude-dates 把它们连同所有相关对一起剔除，--fit huber 用 Huber 估计 速度；质量报告同时打印最小二乘与 Huber 两种离散。--tag 现在可以只给时间序列部分命名变体， 配对产品沿用网络自己的。

docs.title: 第 44 步：距离向偏移隐含的 ΔSTEC
docs.text:
bosar aux range-shift demo_multi --stack native_multi --ionex-dir data/aux/ionex --write
bosar sbas quality demo_multi --network psds

每个日期：ERA5 对流层预测的偏移、残差、以及把残差当成电离层群延迟换算的斜向 TEC 差 （2.33 m 一个像元 ≈ 169 TECU）；有 IONEX 图时并排给出 GIM 值。--write 写进每个日期的 coreg.json 和配准步骤摘要，sbas quality 的逐日期表多出 shift[px]、dSTEC[TECU]、GIM[TECU] 三列。

docs.title: 第 45 步：电离层模型改正（可选）
docs.text:
bosar pipeline sbas demo_multi --network psds --iono --iono-model plane
bosar pipeline psds demo_alos --stack alos_mx --network l --iono --iono-looks 32,32

不加 --iono 什么都不做。加上后每个干涉对跑一次分频估计并拟合模型（C 波段默认 plane，L 波段 默认 filtered），反演时在读入阶段减去模型；链结束时打印模型跨度、W220 对数和三元闭合。

每个模型先过一道合理性门限（幅度、梯度、三元组闭合；--no-iono-gate 关掉它）：不过门的模型被跳过并计数 （W227），坏估计不会进入反演。实测（0.4.1）：C 波段（Sentinel-1 印第安纳波利斯 88 个冬季日期）没有可测的 收益——门限只放行几对，速度变化小于自身噪声；L 波段（ALOS-1 墨西哥城）门限留下约一半模型，产品在 0.01 mm/yr 内不变。门限默认开，因为 filtered 模型可能跟着它所在的形变走，门限的幅度和闭合规则正是 抓这个。用 --iono 时带着门限，比较加与不加的速度图，保留残差和地标序列站得住的那一次；它仍是可选项。

NISAR 一景里有两个频段（0505 模式：A 频段 1221.5 MHz，B 频段 1236.5 MHz，各 5 MHz，同一网格）。把第二 个频段单独配准成一个栈（pipeline stripmap-coregister … --reader nisar --frequency B --tag b），再指名它：

bosar pipeline sbas demo_nisar --network l --iono --iono-band-stack stripmap_b

电离层就由两个整频段估计而不是一个频段的外侧三分之一（iono_split 步骤的 bands 来源）：载波间隔 15 MHz 对 3.3 MHz，噪声增益 58 对 259，同样视数下噪声低四到五倍。两个栈的极化可以不同（该模式下 A 为 HH、B 为 VV），每个频段的干涉图在自己频段内形成。估计器在合成频段上验证过；2026 年的临时 0505 产品 （track 58 / frame 53）B 频段没有信号，所以先看 iono_split 摘要里的 band.coherence_median 再信结果。

docs.title: 第 46 步：长序列的顺序相位连接与星形解缠实验
docs.text:
bosar pipeline psds demo_multi --stack native_multi --network psds_seq --method sequential --ministack 15
bosar pipeline psds demo_multi --unwrap star

sequential：每 15 景一个小栈各自连接，用压缩 SLC 把基准串起来，矩阵永远不超过"小栈 + 之前小栈数" 个日期（N/L 从 0.9 降到 0.2）；摘要报 n_over_l_median。--unwrap star：只以第一景的星形对为 测量，其余对由星形推出（闭合恒为零），独立解缠的相邻对只用来投票整周错误。

88 景实测：sequential 连接快 7 倍、选出的 DS 多 68 %，产品覆盖翻倍（73 % 对 37 %）， 但速度离散从 0.54 变成 0.80 mm/yr，6 % 像元出现整周跳变——由连接相位推出的干涉对天然闭合，反演的 时间相干对它恒为 1.0，把不住关。默认仍是 auto；sequential 是可选项，v0.4.0 改用连接相干做掩膜后再评。 --unwrap star 在 88 景上也是负结果：以第一景为中心的星形对最长跨 1171 天，远端对整片整周错误， 每景三个相邻对的投票压不住（五个日期被改掉 91–98 % 的像元），速度离散 3.6 mm/yr。默认仍是 pairs。

docs.title: 第 47 步：ALOS-1 / ENVISAT / ERS / NISAR 读取器与条带配准链
docs.text:
bosar fetch slc --mission alos --path 186 --frame 370 --flight-direction ascending --range 2007-01-01:2011-12-31 --dry-run
bosar project new demo_alos --storage-mode full
bosar fetch dem demo_alos --bbox -99.30,19.15,-98.85,19.60 --tile-dir data/aux/dem_tiles
bosar pipeline stripmap-coregister demo_alos --product A.zip --product B.zip --reader alos --crop-wkt "POLYGON((...))" --id alos_pair
bosar sbas network demo_alos --stack alos_pair --name pair --max-dt 400 --max-bperp 5000
bosar run demo_alos slc_flatten --step-id slc_flatten_alos_pair --stack alos_pair --mode orbits
bosar sbas prep demo_alos --stack alos_pair --network pair --flat-step slc_flatten_alos_pair

ALOS-1 PALSAR L1.1（CEOS，ASF 的 zip 直接读）、ENVISAT ASAR IMS 与 ERS IMS（Envisat 格式， --reader asar / ers_envisat）、NISAR RSLC（HDF5，尚未见真数据）都读成同一个 StripmapScene； 条带配准链带多普勒中心（几何用 rdr2geo/geo2rdr 的多普勒项，重采样先解调再调制），写出和 TOPS 链一样的 ISCE 目录。原生栈没有存好的干涉图，所以配对要先展平再用 --flat-step 推导； 三景以上直接走 pipeline psds。墨西哥城三种传感器各跑了一对；ALOS 的 16 景序列 （pipeline psds demo_alos --stack alos_mx --network l --k 3，再 pipeline sbas --tag ex --ref-latlon 19.342,-99.088 --exclude-dates 20100522 --fit huber）给出 Nezahualcóyotl −223 mm/yr（LOS，垂直约 −290）、机场 −192、 火山岩参考点 −4 ± 3——与 Chaussard 2014 的图形和量级一致。注意两点：默认参考像元（最好的 DS）会落在 沉降盆地里，要用 --ref-latlon 指到稳定地表；质量判定的 W110/W113 是按稳定区设计的，在 30 cm/yr 的 盆地上会把形变本身判成 NOT USABLE。

docs.title: 第 48 步：比较两条链、4K 导览
docs.text:
bosar compare demo_multi --list
bosar compare demo_multi products/geo_velocity/geocode_velocity_psds_era5.tif ps:psds_link_psds --out compare_out
python scripts/gui_tour.py --project tour/indy_crop --size 1920x1080 --scale 2

bosar compare 是 Results 页"Compare two chains"的命令行版本；导览截图以 2 倍缩放渲染成 3840 × 2160，每一步多一张"点哪里"的动画提示，DInSAR 演示另存一份 4K MP4。

docs.title: 现在的局限与接下来的工作
docs.text:
• 输入可以是 SNAP 导出的 GAMMA/StaMPS 栈、SNAP 桥接的预处理（第 25 步），或 v0.3.0 起 Bosar 自己的 原生 TOPS 配准（第 35、38–40 步：多年栈、定标、三条带拼接）。
  • 时间序列有三条链：SBAS（第 22–27 步）、PS/DS 混合栈（第 31 步）、经典 PSI（第 32 步）。这片 C 波段 植被区上速度噪声在 2–5 mm/yr 量级，一年的数据读不出毫米级形变；质量判定会明确告诉你这一点。
  • 电离层分频估计接进了时间序列链（第 45 步，可选）；ALOS-1、ENVISAT、ERS 的读取器与条带配准链在 v0.4.0 上了真数据（第 47 步），NISAR 只有合成数据；偏移量追踪与斑点滤波在 v0.3.0；安装包在 v0.4.0。

docs.title: 第 49 步：形变区的质量判定、连接相干门限、下载的两处保险
docs.text:
bosar pipeline sbas demo_alos --network l --tag ex2 --area deforming --exclude-dates 20100522 --fit huber --no-geocode
bosar sbas quality demo_alos --network l --tag ex2
bosar sbas quality demo_multi --network psds --step ts_correct_psds_era5 --area deforming
bosar pipeline sbas demo_multi --network psds_seq --tag gate --link-coherence-min 0.7 --tropo era5 --no-geocode
bosar fetch dem demo_alos --bbox -99.30,19.15,-98.85,19.60 --timeout-s 120
  • --area stable | deforming | auto：稳定区规则（默认）会把 30 cm/yr 的沉降盆地判成 NOT USABLE——速度离散本身就是形变、相邻日期之间的整周步进也是形变。deforming 模式下 W110 看 速度减去 1 km 平滑场后的残差离散，W113 看相对每个像元拟合直线的周跳，W114 看去趋势后的共模步进， W112 不再报；没有指定参考点时，参考点自动移到速度场"最稳定五分位"里相干邻域最密的格元 （--stable-end max 对应沉降场景，min 对应隆升）。auto 在离散超过稳定区预期 3 倍时自动切到 deforming。墨西哥城 16 景序列由此判定 USABLE，参考点自动落在 Cerro de la Estrella 火山岩上。
  • W117 两级：超过 20 % 像元离群的日期只记录（报告里标 (info)），≥ 35 % 才是 marginal， 两个以上 marginal 日期才降判定；sbas quality 现在按当前阈值重新评判存储的指标，--step 指定要 报告的步骤，--area 换一套规则看同一产品。
  • --link-coherence-min 0.7：PS/DS 产品的可靠掩膜再用相位连接的时间相干把一次关——顺序 连接的栈反演相干恒为 1，必须用这个门限，所以 pipeline psds --method sequential 默认就带 0.7 （--link-coherence-min 0 关掉）。三年栈上门限留下 82.5 % 的像元，判定仍是 marginal，地标速度 与不加门限的产品差 0.15 mm/yr 以内——门限换掉的是"可靠"的定义，不是产品。
  • fetch dem --timeout-s（v0.4.0 起唯一路径）：直接从 Copernicus 公开桶下载缺的 GLO-30 瓦片到 <project>/aux/dem/tiles/ 再拼接；fetch slc 对已有文件先核一次 MD5、以后用尾 哈希（最后 1 MiB）快速核对，不再只看大小。

docs.title: 第 50 步：安装版——不用源码，从 .exe / .dmg 开始
docs.text:
从 v0.4.0 起 Bosar 有安装程序；下面这些命令在安装版上跑（不是这个开发检出），所以写成普通文本块， check_walkthrough.py 不会执行它们。

  1. 从 Releases 下载：Windows 用 bosar-<版本>-win-x64-setup.exe（按用户安装，不需要管理员；向导里勾上"Add the bosar command line to the user PATH"），macOS 用 bosar-<版本>-mac-arm64.dmg（只有 Apple 芯片版；首次打开 右键 → 打开，或 xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Bosar.app）。
  2. 新开一个终端（PATH 生效），看版本和环境：
bosar version                      # 带 build id：bosar 0.4.0b0 (build 2026…-win-x64 …)
bosar preflight --offline          # P305 显示构建记录；P401 的 SNAPHU 是 "no CS2 solver (MST init)"
  1. 不要任何数据，先跑一遍演示（合成的一对影像、建项目、导入、DInSAR 全链，约一分钟）：
bosar demo my_demo                 # 8 步 done；my_demo/project 是一个普通项目，可以在界面里打开
bosar-gui my_demo/project          # 或从开始菜单 / Applications 打开 Bosar
  1. 有 NVIDIA 显卡的机器：GPU 是插件，装一次（约 1.5 GB，从 PyPI 取 CuPy 和 CUDA 12 运行库，不需要 pip）：
bosar gpu install                  # 或 --no-ctk（系统已有 CUDA 12 工具包时）
bosar preflight --offline          # P202 gpu.plugin ok，P201 gpu.backend 显示显卡

Apple 芯片的 Mac 没有 CUDA，Bosar 在 CPU（NumPy）上跑。 5. 之后第 1–10 步的流程在安装版上完全一样（bosar project new、bosar data import、 bosar pipeline dinsar …）；PS-InSAR（第 32 步的 pipeline psi）和两景差分也都在里面。安装版 的 SNAPHU 没有 CS2 求解器：解缠用 MST 初始化（0.4.1 起所有地方的默认值，步骤摘要里 init: mst）， 结果是同一个最优化问题从另一个起点出发；需要 MCF 初始化的话用源码检出里的 CS2 构建 （packaging/snaphu/build.ps1）并设 unwrap.init=mcf。 6. 许可证：设置页的"About Bosar"卡片显示许可证行（PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0；商业授权联系作者）和 三个文件（Licence… / Notice… / Third-party licences…）；安装目录 _internal/licenses/ 里是同样的文本。

docs.title: 第 51 步：ALOS-2 PALSAR-2 读取器与 JAXA 免费样例
docs.text:
bosar fetch slc --mission alos2 --sample list
bosar fetch slc --mission alos2 --sample 730_greenland
bosar project new demo_alos2 --storage-mode full
bosar fetch dem demo_alos2 --bbox -71.5,77.4,-67.0,78.5 --tile-dir data/aux/dem_tiles
bosar pipeline stripmap-coregister demo_alos2 --product data/raw/alos2/ALOS2150521570-170307 --product data/raw/alos2/ALOS2152591570-170321 --reader alos2 --crop-wkt "POLYGON((-70.1 77.85,-69.1 77.85,-69.1 78.05,-70.1 78.05,-70.1 77.85))" --id alos2_pair

ALOS-2 的 L1.1 CEOS 产品由同一个 ceos_alos 读取器读（按场景号 ALOS2… 区分）：模式来自产品号 （FBS/FBD/FBQ、HBS/HBD/HBQ、UBS/UBD 条带可读，聚束 SBS 与 ScanSAR 识别后拒绝并点名），行头 544 字节带 微秒时标，起始斜距取行头而非 leader 的 range gate（后者在 ALOS-2 上不是到首采样的延迟）。JAXA 的 22 组免费样例可匿名 FTP 取得（--sample list 列出）；ASF 的 ALOS-2 集合目前只有 ScanSAR（每景 30–60 GB）。格陵兰 FBS 对（2017-03-07 / 03-21，14 天）走条带配准链的结果见 v0.4.0 的发布说明。

docs.title: Install
docs.text: Bosar installs like any other program; nothing else is needed — Python, the numerical stack, GDAL / PROJ, the SNAPHU unwrapper and the licence texts are inside the installer.

docs.title: What the machine needs
docs.text:
Bosar runs on an ordinary workstation; what you plan to process decides how much of it you need. The figures below are what the chains used on real data (peak resident memory of the run, measured by the program itself and written to its log), rounded up.

Minimum Recommended Operating system Windows 10 / 11 x64, macOS 12 on Apple silicon (M1 and later; no Intel build) Windows 11, macOS 14 CPU 4 cores 8-16 cores (the SBAS and PS / DS chains run one pair per worker process, --workers) RAM 16 GB 32 GB for crops and pairs; 64 GB for a full-sub-swath Sentinel-1 time series or when SNAP runs beside Bosar Disk 20 GB free for the demo and one Sentinel-1 pair (the download guard of fetch slc defaults to 150 GB free; lower it with --min-free-gb) an SSD with 300-500 GB free for a series (raw scenes 4-8 GB each, the stack about the same again) GPU none (every chain runs on NumPy) NVIDIA with 8 GB or more, CUDA 12 driver, bosar gpu install (the linking and coregistration kernels measured 18-65 x faster; unwrapping stays on the CPU) Network only to fetch data (scenes, orbits, the DEM, weather and ionosphere models) and the GPU plug-in; nothing phones home

What this means in practice:

  • A two-scene DInSAR pair of Sentinel-1 (one sub-swath, a city-sized crop) needs about 2 GB of memory and runs in minutes on the CPU.
  • A Sentinel-1 time series (tens of dates, a full sub-swath) peaks at 30-45 GB of memory in the inversion and takes hours on the CPU; the GPU takes the linking and the inversion down to minutes, the unwrapping stays on the CPU (an hour or more for a full sub-swath). Keep storage_mode: minimal (the default) so that intermediate products are deleted as the chain goes, or budget two to three times the raw data for full.
  • Stripmap stacks (ALOS, ASAR, ERS, NISAR crops of 10-20 km) stay under 4 GB of memory and run on a laptop (the measured peaks are being collected; the figure is an upper bound from the stack sizes).
  • SNAP (optional, for the SNAP bridge) takes whatever Java heap it is given; Bosar gives it half the RAM (at most 64 GB), so 64 GB machines are comfortable there, 16 GB machines are not.
  • Free disk: a download that would breach the free-space guard is refused (fetch slc --min-free-gb); a run warns in its pre-flight table when the project drive is under 10 GiB.

docs.title: Windows 10 / 11 (x64)
docs.text:
1. Download bosar-<version>-win-x64-setup.exe from Releases.
  2. Run it. The installer is per-user (no administrator rights; it installs under Programs\Bosar in your local application-data folder). Tick Add the bosar command line to the user PATH to type bosar in any terminal; tick Open project.json files with Bosar if you like.
  3. Open a new terminal (the PATH takes effect in new windows) and check:
bosar version                  # the version and the build id
bosar preflight --offline      # the environment table; the SNAPHU row says "no CS2 solver (MST init)"

Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" on the first run of an unsigned installer: More info → Run anyway. The .zip next to the installer is the same folder without an installer (unpack anywhere; bosar.exe and bosar-gui.exe are at its top).

docs.title: macOS 12+ (Apple silicon)
docs.text:
1. Download bosar-<version>-mac-arm64.dmg from Releases. Bosar is built for Apple silicon (M1 and later); there is no Intel build.
  2. Open the image and drag Bosar.app to Applications.
  3. The application is not signed with an Apple developer certificate. On the first start macOS says it cannot verify the developer: right-click (or control-click) Bosar.app → Open, and confirm once. Or, in a terminal:
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Bosar.app
  1. The command line lives inside the bundle:
/Applications/Bosar.app/Contents/MacOS/bosar version

Add that folder to your PATH, or make an alias. Apple-silicon Macs have no CUDA; Bosar runs on the CPU there.

docs.title: First steps on an installed build
docs.text:
bosar demo my_demo             # a synthetic pair through the whole DInSAR chain (about a minute)
bosar-gui my_demo/project      # the desktop application on that project (or open it from the Start menu / Applications)

bosar demo writes a small synthetic stack, creates a project, imports it and runs one pair through multilooking, coherence, filtering, unwrapping, geocoding and displacement — the proof that the installation works, with no data and no network. From there the walkthrough (中文) continues with real data.

docs.title: The GPU (NVIDIA, CUDA 12)
docs.text:
The installers run on NumPy. A machine with an NVIDIA GPU adds the GPU afterwards:

bosar gpu install              # CuPy and the CUDA 12 runtime from PyPI into the plug-in folder (about 1.5 GB)
